title: Ezekiel 1:1-3
content: 1-3 Mi Esikel, we papa blong mi Busi, mo mi mi pris* we mi stap wok slef* wetem ol man ples blong yumi ol laen* blong Isrel,* long saed blong Kebara Reva long Babilonia. Nao long namba toti yia, long namba fo manis,* long namba faef dei blong hem, mi mi stap long saed blong reva ya, nao mi luk wan vison.* Hemia long namba faef yia biaen long taem ya we oli holem King Jehoeakin long Jerusalem,* oli karem hem i kam wok slef long Babilonia. Long vison ya, mi luk we skae i open, nao mi luk ol samting we Hae God i soemaot long mi. Nao mi harem we hem i toktok long mi, mo mi harem we paoa blong hem i holem mi.

title: Ezekiel 1:4
content: 4 Mi lukluk i go antap, nao mi luk wan bigfala klaod blong hariken i aot long not, i stap kam, mo laetning i stap laet i kamtru long klaod ya, mo skae i red raonabaot long hem. Mo long ples ya we laetning i stap laet long hem, i gat wan samting i stap saen olsem bras.

title: Ezekiel 1:5
content: 5 Long medel blong hariken ya, mi luk olsem fo laef samting i stap we oli olsem man.

title: Ezekiel 1:6
content: 6 Be olgeta wanwan i gat fo fes mo fo wing.

title: Ezekiel 1:7
content: 7 Ol leg blong olgeta oli stret gud mo leg blong olgeta daon i olsem leg blong buluk. Oli saen olsem bras we man i saenemgud.

title: Ezekiel 1:8
content: 8 Ol samting ya wanwan oli gat fo fes mo fo wing, be aninit long olgeta wing ya wanwan, oli gat han olsem han blong man.

title: Ezekiel 1:9
content: 9 Olgeta wanwan, wan i stretem tu wing blong hem, wan i stretem tu wing blong hem, blong oli mekem wan skwea we en blong ol wing ya blong olgeta i stap tajem olgeta long ol fo kona blong skwea ya. Taem oli go samples, oli muv olsem wan kampani nomo we oli no stap tantanem bodi blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 1:10
content: 10 Ol samting ya wanwan oli gat fo naranarafala fes. Long fored i gat fes blong man, mo long raet saed i gat fes blong laeon, mo long lef saed i gat fes blong bul, mo long baksaed i gat fes blong bigfala pijin ya igel.*

title: Ezekiel 1:11
content: 11 Mo olgeta wanwan, wan i stretem tu wing blong hem, wan i stretem tu wing blong hem, we en blong ol wing ya i stap tajem olgeta, mo oli kavremap bodi blong olgeta long ol narafala tu wing blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 1:12
content: 12 Ol samting ya wanwan oli stap lukluk i go long evri saed, from we olgeta wanwan oli gat fo fes, nao oli stap go long weples we God i wantem olgeta oli go long hem, we oli no save tanem olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 1:13
content: 13 Long medel blong ol samting ya, i gat wan samting olsem sakol faea we i stap laet, no i olsem faea we i stap laet i stap muvmuv olbaot. Faea ya i stap laet, mo i stap sutumaot laet blong hem i go olsem laetning.

title: Ezekiel 1:14
content: 14 Olgeta oli stap muv kwiktaem olsem laetning. Oli stap muv i go, oli stap muv i kam.

title: Ezekiel 1:15
content: 15 Taem mi stap lukluk long ol fo samting ya, mi luk fo wil we oli stap long saed blong olgeta wanwan, we ol wil ya oli go kasem graon.

title: Ezekiel 1:16
content: 16 Ol fo wil ya evriwan oli sem mak nomo, mo olgeta wanwan i saen olsem flas ston ya krisolaet.* Mo ol wil ya wanwan i gat narafala wil i gotru long hem, we i mekem fo kona long medel blong hem,

title: Ezekiel 1:17
content: 17 blong bambae ol wil ya oli save muv i go long ol fo saed, we oli no save tanem olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 1:18
content: 18 Ol aean blong ol wil ya oli bigbigwan we i mekem mi mi fraet blong lukluk olgeta, from we oli gat plante ae blong man i kavremapgud olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 1:19
content: 19 Taem ol samting ya oli muv i go, oli go wetem ol wil ya, mo taem oli girap i go antap, oli go wetem ol wil ya.

title: Ezekiel 1:20
content: 20 Weples we God i wantem olgeta oli go long hem, olgeta oli stap muv wetem ol wil ya, from we ol wil ya oli haf blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 1:21
content: 21 Nao oltaem, taem ol samting ya oli muv i go, no oli stanap, no oli girap i go antap, be ol wil ya tu oli mekem sem samting, from we oli haf blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 1:22
content: 22 Antap long hed blong ol samting ya, i gat wan samting olsem ruf we i raon, mo i saen we i saen olsem glas we i klia gud, we i mekem mi mi harem we mi no naf blong go klosap long hem.

title: Ezekiel 1:23
content: 23 Olgeta oli stanap aninit long ruf ya, mo olgeta wanwan, wan i stretem tu wing blong hem, wan i stretem tu wing blong hem, we en blong ol wing ya i stap tajem olgeta, mo oli kavremap bodi blong olgeta long ol narafala tu wing blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 1:24
content: 24 Taem oli flae mi harem noes blong ol wing blong olgeta we i olsem noes blong bigfala solwota we i brok long rif, mo i olsem noes blong wan bigfala kampani blong ol soldia, mo i olsem voes blong God ya we i gat olgeta paoa. Taem oli no flae, wing blong olgeta i godaon.

title: Ezekiel 1:25
content: 25 Mo i gat wan voes i kamaot antap long ruf ya, antap long hed blong olgeta, i toktok i kam.

title: Ezekiel 1:26
content: 26 Antap long ruf ya i gat wan samting olsem bigfala jea blong king i stap we oli wokem long flas ston ya safaea,* mo mi luk olsem we i gat wan man i stap sidaon long hem.

title: Ezekiel 1:27
content: 27 Man ya, i stat long ples blong strap blong hem, i go antap, bodi blong hem i saen olsem bras we i stap bon insaed long faea, mo i gat faea i laet raonabaot long hem. Mo i stat long ples blong strap i godaon, bodi blong hem i olsem faea we i laet, mo bigfala laet i stap saen raonabaot long hem,

title: Ezekiel 1:28
content: 28 we i gat olgeta kala blong renbo long hem. Bigfala laet ya i soemaot we Hae God i stap. Nao taem mi luk samting ya, mi foldaon we fes blong mi i godaon long graon. Nao mi harem Hae God i toktok.

title: Ezekiel 2:1
content: 1 Long mi, i talem se, “Man blong wol ya. Yu stanap. Mi wantem toktok long yu.”

title: Ezekiel 2:2
content: 2 Taem hem i stap toktok long mi, Spirit blong hem i kam long mi, i mekem mi mi stanap. Nao mi harem hem i gohed i talem se,

title: Ezekiel 2:3
content: 3 “Man blong wol ya. Bambae mi sanem yu yu go long ol laen* blong Isrel* ya. Olgeta oli girap oli agens long mi, mo oli stap agens long mi yet olsem we ol bubu blong olgeta bifo oli stap mekem.

title: Ezekiel 2:4
content: 4 Olgeta oli stronghed tumas, mo oli no save ona long mi. Be mi mi Hae God, mi Masta* blong yufala, taswe mi wantem sanem yu yu go blong talemaot ol samting long olgeta we mi wantem talem long olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 2:5
content: 5 Olgeta ya oli stronghed, mo nating we oli lesin long yu no oli no lesin long yu, be bambae oli mas save se i gat wan profet i stap wetem olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 2:6
content: 6 “Be yu yu no mas fraet long olgeta ya, mo long ol tok we bambae oli sakem long yu. Bambae oli mekemhed, oli no save lesin long yu, mo bambae oli ting rabis long yu. Bambae i olsem we yu stap sidaon long ol skopion long medel blong ol ropnil. Be yu no fraet long ol stronghed ya mo long ol samting ya we bambae oli talem.

title: Ezekiel 2:7
content: 7 Yu mas talemaot tok blong mi long olgeta, nating we bambae oli lesin long yu no oli no save lesin. Yu mas save we olgeta ya, oltaem oli stap girap oli agens long mi.

title: Ezekiel 2:8
content: 8 “Yu mas lesin gud long ol samting we bambae mi talem long yu naoia. Yu yu no mas girap agens long mi olsem olgeta ya. Yu openem maot blong yu, yu kakae samting ya we bambae mi givim long yu naoia.”

title: Ezekiel 2:9
content: 9 Nao mi luk wan han i kamaot we i stap holem wan buk* we oli raetem ol toktok i stap long hem.

title: Ezekiel 2:10
content: 10 Nao han ya i openem buk ya long fes blong mi, mo mi luk we ol toktok i stap long evri haf blong hem. Long buk ya oli raetem krae blong ol man we oli sore, mo krae blong olgeta we oli krae bigwan, mo krae blong olgeta we oli stap harem nogud tumas long bodi blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 3:1
content: 1 Nao Hae God i talem long mi se, “Man blong wol ya. Yu kakae buk ya, nao bambae yu go talemaot tok blong mi long ol laen blong Isrel* ya.”

title: Ezekiel 3:2
content: 2 Nao mi openem maot blong mi, mo hem i givim buk ya long mi blong mi kakae.

title: Ezekiel 3:3
content: 3 Hem i talem se, “Yu kakae buk ya we mi givim long yu naoia, yu fulap gud long hem.” Nao mi kakae buk ya, mo mi harem i swit we i swit olsem hani.*

title: Ezekiel 3:4
content: 4 Nao Hae God i talem long mi se, “Olgeta samting we mi talem long yu, yu yu mas go talemaot long ol laen blong Isrel.

title: Ezekiel 3:5
content: 5 Bambae mi no save sanem yu yu go long ol man blong narafala kantri we lanwis blong olgeta i strong tumas long yu, bambae mi sanem yu yu go long ol laen blong Isrel nomo.

title: Ezekiel 3:6
content: 6 Sipos mi sanem yu yu go long ol kantri we oli gat plante man, mo ol lanwis blong olgeta oli strong tumas we yu yu no save nating, bambae olgeta oli save lesin long yu.

title: Ezekiel 3:7
content: 7 Be ol laen blong Isrel bambae oli no glad nating blong lesin long yu, from we oli no wantem nating blong lesin long mi. Olgeta evriwan oli stronghed, mo oli no save lesin nating.

title: Ezekiel 3:8
content: 8 Be naoia bambae mi mekem yu yu strong moa blong oli no save winim yu.

title: Ezekiel 3:9
content: 9 Yu no fraet long ol stronghed ya. Yu no ting se yu no save winim olgeta. Bambae mi mekem yu yu strong we yu strong moa winim olgeta.”

title: Ezekiel 3:10
content: 10 Nao Hae God i gohed i talem long mi se, “Yu lesin gud long mi. Olgeta samting ya we bambae mi talem long yu, yu mas holemgud long tingting blong yu.

title: Ezekiel 3:11
content: 11 Naoia yu yu stap long Babilonia, mo ol man ples blong yu oli stap wok slef* wetem yu long ples ya. Bambae yu girap, yu go talemaot ol samting ya long olgeta we mi bambae mi talem, nating we oli lesin long yu no oli no lesin.”

title: Ezekiel 3:12
content: 12 Nao Spirit blong Hae God i leftemap mi mi go antap, mo mi harem wan man i tok long baksaed blong mi, we voes blong hem i olsem noes blong bigfala etkwek. Hem i talem se, “Hae God i hae we i hae, mo hem i stap long heven. Yumi presem nem blong hem.”

title: Ezekiel 3:13
content: 13 Nao mi harem ol fo samting ya oli stap mekem noes long ol wing blong olgeta, mo mi harem noes blong ol wil blong olgeta tu i bigwan olsem noes blong etkwek.

title: Ezekiel 3:14
content: 14 Nao Spirit blong Hae God i leftemap mi i karem mi mi go, mo mi harem nogud, mi kros we mi kros. Be Spirit blong hem i kam long mi we i strong we i strong.

title: Ezekiel 3:15
content: 15 Nao mi kamtru bakegen long Kebara Reva, long taon ya Telabib we ol laen blong Isrel oli stap wok slef long hem. Mi stap wetem olgeta long ples ya seven dei, from we mi stap harem nogud tumas long ol samting ya we mi mi luk.

title: Ezekiel 3:16
content: 16 Nao biaen long seven dei ya, Hae God i talem long mi se,

title: Ezekiel 3:17
content: 17 “Man blong wol ya. Mi mi mekem yu yu kam wan wajman blong lukaot long ol laen* blong Isrel.* Bambae yu tekem strong tok ya blong mi we mi talem long yu, yu go talem long olgeta blong wonem olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 3:18
content: 18 Sipos mi talemaot se wan man nogud bambae i ded, be yu yu no go tok long hem, blong hem i jenisim fasin blong hem blong i sevem laef blong hem, man ya bambae i ded from ol sin ya blong hem, be ded blong hem bambae i fol blong yu.

title: Ezekiel 3:19
content: 19 Be sipos yu tok long wan man nogud, blong hem i stretem laef blong hem, be hem i no lego ol rabis fasin blong hem, hem bambae i ded from ol sin ya blong hem, be yu yu sevem laef blong yu.

title: Ezekiel 3:20
content: 20 “Mo bakegen, sipos wan stret man i stat blong mekem ol rabis fasin, nao mi mekem hem i stap long poen we bambae hem i ded from, mo yu no go toktok long hem blong hem i tanem tingting blong hem, bambae hem i ded from ol sin ya blong hem. Man ya, bambae mi no moa save tingbaot ol gudgudfala samting we hem i bin wokem, mo ded blong hem bambae i fol blong yu.

title: Ezekiel 3:21
content: 21 Be sipos yu tok long wan stret man, blong hem i no mekem samting nogud, mo hem i harem tok blong yu, bambae hem i stap laef, mo yu tu bambae yu sevem laef blong yu.”

title: Ezekiel 3:22
content: 22 Nao taem mi stap long ples ya, mi harem we paoa blong Hae God i kam long mi, mo hem i talem long mi se, “Yu girap, yu go long bigfala levelples ya, nao bambae mi toktok long yu long ples ya.”

title: Ezekiel 3:23
content: 23 Nao mi girap, mi go long bigfala levelples ya, mo mi luk wan bigfala laet i saen we i saen. Laet ya i olsem bigfala laet ya we mi luk long saed blong Kebara Reva, mo i soemaot we Hae God i stap long ples ya, mo mi foldaon we fes blong mi i kasem graon.

title: Ezekiel 3:24
content: 24 Hae God i Masta* blong yumi, mo Spirit blong hem i kam long mi i mekem mi mi stanap. Hem i talem long mi se, “Man blong wol ya. Yu gobak long haos blong yu, yu go insaed, yu satem doa, yu stap insaed.

title: Ezekiel 3:25
content: 25 Bambae ol man oli fasem yu long rop, mo yu no save go wokbaot long fes blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 3:26
content: 26 Mi bambae mi mekem tang blong yu i fas, nao bambae yu no save toktok blong wonem ol man ya we oli girap oli stap agens long mi.

title: Ezekiel 3:27
content: 27 Be sipos mi toktok long yu bakegen, bambae mi mekem yu yu save toktok bakegen, nao bambae yu save go talemaot ol samting ya we mi stap talem. Sam long olgeta bambae oli lesin long yu, be sam long olgeta bambae oli no save lesin, from we olgeta ya oli man blong girap agens long mi.”

title: Ezekiel 4:1
content: 1 Nao Hae God i talem long mi se, “Man blong wol ya. Yu go tekem wan brikis, yu putum long graon, mo yu katem pija blong taon ya Jerusalem* long hem.

title: Ezekiel 4:2
content: 2 Nao bambae yu mekem pija blong olgeta samting we ol enemi bambae oli mekem long taon ya. Bambae yu digim hol i goraon long pija blong taon ya, mo yu hivimap graon i goraon long hem, mo yu mekem pija blong ol haos tapolen blong ol enemi, mo yu mekem pija blong ol bigbigfala wud blong kilimdaon stonwol blong taon ya.

title: Ezekiel 4:3
content: 3 Nao yu tekem wan trei we oli wokem long aean, yu stanemap olsem wol long medel blong yu mo pija blong taon ya, we taon ya i stap narasaed, mo yu narasaed. Nao yu lukluk i go long taon ya olsem we yu stap gad long hem. Be yu yu olsem ol enemi we oli raonem taon ya blong blokem ol man blong hem oli no save kamaot. Hemia bambae i wan saen long ol laen* blong Isrel.*

title: Ezekiel 4:4-5
content: 4-5 “Nao yu ledaon long lef saed blong yu, mo bambae yu stap harem nogud from ol sin blong ol laen blong Isrel long not. Bambae yu stap harem nogud olsem gogo kasem tri handred naenti dei blong soemaot panis blong olgeta. Long tri handred naenti dei ya, wan dei i saen blong wan yia, wan dei i saen blong wan yia, we bambae oli stap harem nogud from panis ya we mi stap givim long olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 4:6
content: 6 Taem yu finisim ol samting ya, bambae yu ledaon long raet saed blong yu, blong yu stap harem nogud from sin blong ol man Juda.* Bambae yu mekem olsem gogo kasem foti dei, we bambae wan dei i saen blong wan yia, wan dei i saen blong wan yia, we bambae oli stap harem nogud from panis ya we mi bambae mi givim long olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 4:7
content: 7 “Nao yu lukluk strong long pija ya blong Jerusalem we ol enemi oli raonem, mo yu leftemap han blong yu, yu talemaot tok blong mi agens long ol man blong hem.

title: Ezekiel 4:8
content: 8 Bambae mi fasem yu, nao yu no save tantanem yu, gogo yu finisim olgeta dei ya we yu stap soemaot we ol enemi bambae oli stap raonem taon ya.

title: Ezekiel 4:9
content: 9 “Mo bambae yu tekem wit,* mo bale,* wetem tu kaen bin, mo tu narakaen wit we nem blong tufala milet mo spel, nao yu miksimap olgeta wanples blong mekem bred long hem. Hemia nao kakae we bambae yu stap kakae long tri handred naenti dei ya we bambae yu stap ledaon long lef saed blong yu.

title: Ezekiel 4:10
content: 10 Bambae yu save kakae haf blong wan smol bred nomo long wan dei, mo hemia nomo bambae i holem yu gogo kasem nekis dei blong hem.

title: Ezekiel 4:11
content: 11 Mo bambae yu gat smol wota nomo blong yu yu dring, we tu smol pankin nomo long wan dei.

title: Ezekiel 4:12
content: 12 Nao evri dei long fes blong ol man, bambae yu tekem sitsit blong man, yu mekem i drae gud blong mekem faea long hem, nao yu kukum bred blong yu long hem, mo yu kakae.”

title: Ezekiel 4:13
content: 13 Nao Hae God i talem long mi se, “Samting ya, hem i saen we bambae ol laen blong Isrel oli mas kakae ol mit we Loa i blokem se i tabu blong yufala i kakae. Hemia long taem ya we bambae mi ronemaot olgeta oli go stap long ol narafala kantri.”

title: Ezekiel 4:14
content: 14 Be mi talem se, “Hae God, yu yu Masta* blong mi. Neva mi mekem mi mi doti long fes blong yu. I stat long taem we mi mi pikinini, i kam kasem tede, neva mi kakae mit blong anamol we hem i ded hem wan, no we ol narafala anamol oli kilim i ded. Neva mi kakae ol kakae we i doti long fes blong yu.”

title: Ezekiel 4:15
content: 15 Nao Hae God i talem long mi se, “Oraet, bambae mi letem yu yu tekem sitsit blong buluk nomo, blong yu mekem faea long hem blong kukum bred blong yu long hem.”

title: Ezekiel 4:16
content: 16 Nao hem i gohed i talem se, “Man blong wol ya. Bambae mi mekem we ol man Jerusalem oli no save aot long taon blong go lukaot kakae blong olgeta. Mo taem oli skelemgud kakae we bambae oli kakae, mo wota we bambae oli dring, bambae oli harem nogud, oli stap wari oltaem nomo, from we ol samting ya i smol tumas.

title: Ezekiel 4:17
content: 17 Bambae ol kakae blong olgeta mo wota blong olgeta i finis, mo bambae tingting blong olgeta i foldaon olgeta, mo bambae oli stap bunbun from ol sin blong olgeta.”

title: Ezekiel 5:1
content: 1 Nao Hae God i talem se, “Man blong wol ya. Yu tekem wan naef blong faet we i sap gud, yu katemaot hea blong yu wetem mustas blong yu, nao yu skelem olgeta long skel, mo yu seraot olgeta long tri haf.

title: Ezekiel 5:2
content: 2 Taem we yu soemaot we ol enemi oli no moa blokem taon ya, oli winim finis, bambae yu tekem fas haf blong hea ya, yu bonem antap long pija blong taon ya. Mo namba tu haf blong hem, bambae yu tekem, yu katkatem long naef blong faet raonabaot long taon ya. Mo namba tri haf blong hem, bambae yu sakem, blong win i karem i go, nao mi bambae mi ronem olgeta long naef blong faet blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 5:3
content: 3 Nao bambae yu pikimap smol nomo long olgeta ya we win i stap karem i go, yu fasem long en blong klos blong yu.

title: Ezekiel 5:4
content: 4 Nao bambae yu tekemaot sam long klos ya bakegen, yu sakem i go long faea blong i bon evriwan, mo smok blong hem bambae i goaot i kasem olgeta laen* blong Isrel.*”

title: Ezekiel 5:5
content: 5 Hae God i Masta* blong yumi, mo hem i talem long mi se, “Yu luk Jerusalem* ya. Mi putum hem i stap long medel blong wol ya, mo ol narafala kantri oli stap raonabaot long hem.

title: Ezekiel 5:6
content: 6 Be ol man blong hem oli stap girap agens long ol tok blong mi, mo oli stap soemaot we oli nogud moa i winim ol man blong ol narafala kantri ya. Oli no obei long mi nating, oli nogud moa, i winim ol kantri ya. Oli sakem ol tok blong mi, oli no wantem nating, mo oli no wantem holem ol loa blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 5:7
content: 7 “Ol man Jerusalem. Yufala i mas harem tok blong mi. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala. Fasin ya we yufala i no obei long ol loa blong mi, mo yufala i no holem ol tok blong mi, hem i mekem tumas trabol long mi, i winim ol narafala kantri ya we oli stap raonabaot long yufala. Yufala i stap folem ol kastom blong olgeta ya,

title: Ezekiel 5:8
content: 8 mo from samting ya, mi mi talem long yufala, se mi mi enemi blong yufala. Bambae mi jajem yufala, stret long fes blong ol narafala kantri ya.

title: Ezekiel 5:9
content: 9 From we yufala i stap mekem ol samting we mi mi no wantem nating, bambae mi givim wan panis long yufala we neva mi givim long yufala samtaem, mo biaen bambae mi no moa save panisim yufala bakegen olsem.

title: Ezekiel 5:10
content: 10 Bambae yufala i gat hadtaem blong kasem kakae, nao sam long yufala bambae oli kakae ol pikinini blong olgeta, mo sam long ol pikinini bambae oli kakae ol olfala blong olgeta. Bambae mi panisim yufala, mo haf blong yufala we i stap laef bambae mi ronemaot olgeta oli go stap olbaot long ol narafala kantri.

title: Ezekiel 5:11
content: 11 “Mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala. Mi mi laef, mi stap we mi stap, mo tok blong mi i olsem. From we yufala i mekem haos* blong mi i kam doti long ol samting nogud ya we yufala i stap mekem, bambae mi spolem yufala we mi no gat sore long yufala nating.

title: Ezekiel 5:12
content: 12 Bambae mi seraot yufala long tri kampani. Fas kampani bambae oli hanggri mo oli sik gogo oli ded insaed long taon ya. Mo seken kampani, bambae ol enemi oli kilim olgeta long faet afsaed long taon. Mo namba tri kampani, bambae mi mekem olgeta oli go wanwan olbaot long ol narafala kantri, mo bambae mi tekem naef blong faet blong mi, mi ronem olgeta i go.

title: Ezekiel 5:13
content: 13 “Long fasin ya, bambae mi soemaot we mi kros we mi kros tumas long yufala, be taem mi panisim yufala finis, bambae kros blong mi i finis, nao mi harem gud bakegen. Nao bambae yufala i save haremsave we mi Hae God, mi tok from we mi harem nogud long yufala. Bambae mi panisim yufala from we tingting blong yufala i no moa stap strong long mi, yufala i tanem baksaed long mi, nao yufala i girap, yufala i biaen long ol narafala god.

title: Ezekiel 5:14
content: 14 Mi bambae mi spolemgud yufala, nao olgeta man blong ol kantri we oli stap raonabaot long yufala we oli wokbaot long ples ya bambae oli luk yufala, mo oli stap laf nogud long yufala.

title: Ezekiel 5:15
content: 15 “Taem mi kros we mi kros long yufala, bambae mi panisim yufala, mo olgeta kantri ya bambae oli fraet we i fraet. Bambae oli lukluk long yufala, oli ting rabis long yufala, nao bambae oli laf nogud long yufala.

title: Ezekiel 5:16
content: 16 Bambae mi mekem yufala i sot long kakae, nao bambae yufala i stap hanggri gogo yufala i harem i nogud we i nogud, olsem we man i sutum yufala long ara we i sap we i sap, blong kilim yufala i ded.

title: Ezekiel 5:17
content: 17 Bambae mi mekem ol pikinini blong yufala oli ded long hanggri, mo bambae mi sanem ol wael anamol tu oli kam blong kilim olgeta oli ded. Mo yufala, bambae mi letem yufala i ded long rabis sik mo long faet. Mi mi Hae God, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 6:1
content: 1 Hae God i Masta* blong yumi, mo hem i toktok long mi long wan vison,

title: Ezekiel 6:2
content: 2 i talem se, “Man blong wol ya. Yu lukluk i go long ol hil ya blong Isrel,* yu talemaot tok blong mi agens long olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 6:3
content: 3 Yu talem long ol hil ya blong oli harem tok blong mi. Ol bigbigfala hil, mo ol smosmol hil, mo ol krik, mo ol levelples long medel blong ol hil, olgeta evriwan oli mas harem. Mi bambae mi sanem ol enemi i kam wetem ol naef blong faet blong olgeta, blong oli spolem ol ples we ol laen* blong Isrel oli stap go mekem wosip long ol aedol ya long hem.

title: Ezekiel 6:4
content: 4 Ol olta blong bonem sakrefaes, mo ol olta blong bonem insens,* bambae oli brebrekem olgeta evriwan, mo bambae oli kilim ol man long ples ya long fes blong ol aedol ya blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 6:5
content: 5 Bambae ol enemi oli sakem ol dedbodi blong olgeta long fes blong ol aedol ya, mo bambae ol bun blong olgeta i stap olbaot raon long ol olta ya.

title: Ezekiel 6:6
content: 6 Bambae ol enemi oli spolemgud ol taon blong olgeta, mo bambae oli smasemgud ol olta mo ol aedol blong olgeta, we bambae oli flatemgud olgeta. Mo bambae oli smasemgud ol olta ya blong olgeta we oli stap bonem insens long hem, mo olgeta samting blong olgeta bambae oli lus.

title: Ezekiel 6:7
content: 7 Bambae ol enemi oli kilim olgeta oli ded long evri ples, nao olgeta we oli stap laef yet bambae oli savegud we mi mi Hae God.

title: Ezekiel 6:8
content: 8 “Be sam long olgeta we oli stap laef, bambae mi ronemaot olgeta oli go stap wanwan olbaot long ol narafala kantri,

title: Ezekiel 6:9
content: 9 we bambae oli wok slef* long ol ples ya. Nao bambae oli tingbaot mi, mo bambae oli save we mi mi panisim olgeta. Mo bambae mi mekem olgeta oli sem gud, from we oli no bilif long mi, oli gowe long mi, mo oli wantem ol narafala god ya moa, i winim we oli wantem mi. Mo bambae oli luksave we laef blong olgeta i nogud we i nogud from we oli stap mekem ol rabis fasin we i nogud olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 6:10
content: 10 Nao bambae oli savegud we mi mi Hae God, mo ol tok ya we mi talem blong wonem olgeta, se bigfala trabol bambae i kasem olgeta, mi no jes talem nomo, bambae mi mekem i kamtru.”

title: Ezekiel 6:11
content: 11 Mo Hae God i talem long mi se, “Bambae ol laen blong Isrel* oli ded long faet, mo long hanggri, mo long rabis sik. Mo naoia yu yu mas harem nogud tumas from. Yu mas sore we yu krae we yu krae. Yu mas talem se, ‘!Sore tumas long yufala! !Sore tumas from we yufala i mekem plante samting nogud!’

title: Ezekiel 6:12
content: 12 I tru tumas. Olgeta evriwan bambae oli mas ded. Olgeta we oli stap longwe bambae oli ded long rabis sik, mo olgeta we oli stap klosap bambae oli ded long faet. Mo olgeta we oli laef yet bambae oli hanggri gogo oli ded from. Bambae oli haremsave paoa blong kros blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 6:13
content: 13 Bambae ol dedbodi blong olgeta oli stap olbaot long ol ples we ol aedol wetem ol olta blong olgeta oli stap long hem. Antap long ol hil, mo aninit long ol bigbigfala tri, mo aninit long ol oktri,* mo long olgeta ples we oli stap mekem sakrefaes long hem, be ol dedbodi ya bambae oli stap olbaot long hem. Nao bambae olgeta evriwan oli savegud we mi mi Hae God.

title: Ezekiel 6:14
content: 14 Bambae mi leftemap han blong mi, mi spolem kantri blong olgeta, we mi spolemgud, we bambae i no gat man i stap long hem. Bambae mi mekem i kam rabis olgeta, i stat long draeples long saot i go kasem taon ya Riblaha long not, i kavremap olgeta ples we ol laen blong Isrel oli stap long hem. Nao bambae olgeta evriwan oli savegud we mi mi Hae God.”

title: Ezekiel 7:1
content: 1 Hae God i Masta* blong yumi, mo hem i toktok long mi long wan vison bakegen,

title: Ezekiel 7:2
content: 2 i talem se, “Man blong wol ya. Mi mi talem long yufala ol laen* blong Isrel,* se taem blong kantri blong yufala i stap kam nao.

title: Ezekiel 7:3
content: 3 “Taem we bambae yufala i lus i kam klosap finis. Bambae yufala i haremsave kros blong mi from we mi stap jajem yufala from ol samting ya we yufala i mekem. Bambae mi panisim yufala from olgeta rabis fasin blong yufala.

title: Ezekiel 7:4
content: 4 Bambae mi no save gat sore long yufala, mo mi no save sevem laef blong yufala. Bambae mi panisim yufala from ol rabis samting we yufala i mekem, blong bambae yufala i savegud we mi mi Hae God.”

title: Ezekiel 7:5
content: 5 Mo hem i talem se, “I gat ol trabol i stap kam, we bambae wan i kam, i finis, narawan i kam, i finis, narawan bakegen i kam.

title: Ezekiel 7:6
content: 6 Dei blong yufala i finis nao. Bambae yufala i lus. Janis blong yufala i finis.

title: Ezekiel 7:7
content: 7 Taem i stap kam nao we yufala evriwan we i stap long kantri ya, bambae yufala i lus olgeta. Oltaem yufala i stap harem gud long ol lafet blong yufala long ol ples blong wosip blong yufala antap long ol hil, be taem blong hem klosap i finis. Bambae trabol i kasem yufala long ol ples ya, we bambae i mekem tingting blong yufala i paspas olbaot.

title: Ezekiel 7:8
content: 8 “I no longtaem bambae yufala i luk paoa blong kros blong mi. Bambae mi jajem yufala from ol samting ya we yufala i mekem, mo bambae mi panisim yufala from ol rabis fasin ya blong yufala.

title: Ezekiel 7:9
content: 9 Bambae mi no save gat sore long yufala, mo mi no save sevem laef blong yufala. Bambae mi panisim yufala from ol rabis samting we yufala i mekem, blong bambae yufala i savegud we mi mi Hae God, mo we mi nao mi stap panisim yufala.

title: Ezekiel 7:10
content: 10 “!Yu luk! Ol man oli stap praod we i bitim mak, mo oltaem faet i stap gohed. !Be dei blong olgeta we bambae oli lus, klosap i kamtru!

title: Ezekiel 7:11
content: 11 Fasin blong faet i kam bigwan we i stap mekem ol man oli stap mekem ol fasin we i nogud olgeta. Bambae i no gat wan long olgeta i save stap. Ol gudgudfala samting we i mekem olgeta oli rij, mo oli flas, mo oli gat hae nem, bambae i no moa gat.

title: Ezekiel 7:12
content: 12 “Taem i stap kam, mo dei i stap klosap nomo we mi bambae mi panisim olgeta man evriwan. Nao man we i stap salem ol samting, bambae i no moa save soemaot se i harem nogud we i salem ol samting long smol praes nomo. Mo man we i stap pem ol samting, bambae i no moa save glad we hem i pem ol samting we praes i gud nomo.

title: Ezekiel 7:13
content: 13 Bambae i no moa gat man i stap, we i save salem ol samting blong winimbak mane blong hem, from we mi mi kros long olgeta evriwan. Olgeta oli man nogud, mo bambae oli no moa save stap.”

title: Ezekiel 7:14
content: 14 Nao long vison ya, Hae God i talem long mi se, “Bambae pupu i krae, mo olgeta man oli mekemrere blong go faet. Be bambae i no gat man i muv, from we mi mi kros long olgeta, nao bambae mi panisim olgeta evriwan.

title: Ezekiel 7:15
content: 15 Bambae i gat faet i stap gohed long ol bigfala rod long taon ya Jerusalem,* mo ol man we oli stap insaed long ol haos blong olgeta, bambae oli stap hanggri, mo bambae rabis sik i stap spolem olgeta. Olgeta we oli stap afsaed long taon bambae oli ded long faet. Mo olgeta we oli stap insaed long taon, bambae oli stap ded long hanggri, mo long rabis sik.

title: Ezekiel 7:16
content: 16 Mo sam long olgeta bambae oli ronwe i go antap long ol hil, olsem ol sotleg* we oli stap daon long levelples, nao oli fraet, oli flae i go antap long ol hil. Olgeta evriwan bambae oli harem nogud, oli stap krae from ol sin blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 7:17
content: 17 Olgeta man evriwan, bambae han blong olgeta i slak, mo leg blong olgeta i seksek bigwan.

title: Ezekiel 7:18
content: 18 Bambae oli putum ol rabis klos, mo bambae oli stap seksek we i seksek. Bambae oli katemaot hea blong olgeta blong soemaot we oli sem we i sem, mo oli harem nogud tumas.

title: Ezekiel 7:19
content: 19 Bambae olgeta oli luk ol silva mo ol gol blong olgeta olsem samting we i nogud we i nogud, mo bambae oli sakem olgeta olbaot long ol rod long taon. Taem we mi mi panisim olgeta from we mi kros we mi kros gud long olgeta, bambae ol samting ya i no save sevem olgeta. Oli no save yusum blong mekem olgeta oli harem gud long laef blong olgeta, mo oli no save pem ol kakae long hem, blong oli kakae oli harem gud. Ol gol mo ol silva ya nao i lidim olgeta blong oli mekem sin.

title: Ezekiel 7:20
content: 20 Fastaem ol man ya oli stap glad tumas long ol flas ston blong olgeta, be oli girap, oli yusum olgeta blong wokem ol aedol blong olgeta we oli nogud we i nogud olgeta long fes blong mi. From samting ya nao, mi mekem ol man ya oli lukluk nogud long ol gudgudfala samting ya.

title: Ezekiel 7:21
content: 21 “Bambae mi letem ol man blong ol narafala kantri we oli man blong brekem loa oli kam stil long ol man ya, mo oli kam tektekemaot ol gudgudfala samting ya blong olgeta, mo oli mekem ol samting ya i no moa tabu.

title: Ezekiel 7:22
content: 22 Mi mi laekem haos* blong mi tumas, be sipos ol enemi ya oli go insaed long hem, oli mekem i no moa tabu, i kam doti long fes blong mi, bambae mi no save blokem olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 7:23
content: 23 “Yu mas wokem ol jen blong fasem ol man long hem, from we olbaot long kantri ya ol man oli stap kilim ol narafala man, mo ol taon oli fulap long ol man we oli stap faet, oli stap kilkilim olgeta oli ded.

title: Ezekiel 7:24
content: 24 Bambae mi tekem ol man blong ol narafala kantri we oli mowas olgeta, mi letem olgeta oli kam long ples blong yufala, nao bambae oli holem ol haos blong yufala i blong olgeta. Mo taem we mi letem olgeta oli mekem ol ples blong wosip blong yufala oli no moa tabu, bambae ol nambawan strong man blong yufala oli lusum paoa blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 7:25
content: 25 Taem i stap kam we bambae tingting blong yufala i foldaon olgeta. Bambae yufala i lukaot pis, be bambae yufala i no save faenem.

title: Ezekiel 7:26
content: 26 I gat ol trabol i stap kam, we bambae wan i kam, i finis, narawan i kam, i finis, narawan bakegen i kam. Long taem ya ol man bambae oli stap pasem ol badnius i go olbaot. Bambae oli go luk ol profet, blong askem long olgeta blong oli talemaot ol vison blong olgeta, be nogat. Ol pris* bambae oli no moa gat gudfala tingting blong tijim ol man long hem, mo ol elda* bambae oli no moa gat tok blong givhan long olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 7:27
content: 27 Bambae king i harem nogud tumas, mo tingting blong pikinini blong hem bambae i foldaon olgeta, mo bambae olgeta man oli fraet, oli seksek. Bambae mi panisim olgeta from olgeta samting we oli mekem, mo bambae mi jajem olgeta sem mak nomo, olsem we olgeta oli stap jajem ol narafala man. Nao bambae oli savegud we mi mi Hae God.”

title: Ezekiel 8:1
content: 1 Nao long namba sikis yia we yumi stap wok slef* long ples ya, long namba sikis manis,* long namba faef dei blong hem, ol lida blong ol man Juda* we oli stap wok slef long ples ya, oli stap sidaon wetem mi long haos blong mi. Nao wantaem nomo, paoa blong Hae God we i Masta* blong yumi i kam long mi, mo mi luk wan vison.

title: Ezekiel 8:2
content: 2 Nao long vison ya, mi lukluk i go antap, mi luk olsem we i gat wan man i stap we faea i laet raonabaot long hem. I stat long ples blong strap i godaon, bodi blong hem i olsem faea, mo i stat long ples blong strap i go antap, bodi blong hem i stap saen we i saen olsem bras we i saen gud.

title: Ezekiel 8:3
content: 3 Nao mi luk olsem we hem i pusum han blong hem, i holem hea blong mi. Nao Spirit blong hem i leftemap mi mi go antap long medel blong skae mo graon, mo i tekem mi mi go long Jerusalem,* nao mi haremsave se man ya, Hae God ya. Hem i tekem mi mi go insaed long wan doa blong smol yad ya insaed long bigfala yad blong haos* blong hem, we doa ya i stap long saed i go long not. Long ples ya, i gat wan aedol i stanap, we i mekem hem i harem nogud, i kros we i kros, from we ol man blong hem oli girap, oli lego hem, oli go biaen long aedol ya.

title: Ezekiel 8:4
content: 4 Nao long ples ya, mi luk wan bigfala laet we i saen we i saen. Laet ya i soemaot we God blong yumi i stap long ples ya. Laet ya i olsem hemia we mi luk bifo, long bigfala levelples ya klosap long Kebara Reva.

title: Ezekiel 8:5
content: 5 Nao hem i talem long mi se, “Man blong wol ya. Yu lukluk i go long not.” Nao mi lukluk i go, mo mi luk wan aedol i stanap long doa ya we i blong kam long olta. Mo aedol ya tu i mekem hem i harem nogud, i kros.

title: Ezekiel 8:6
content: 6 Nao hem i talem bakegen long mi se, “?Yu luk ol samting ya we ol man ya oli stap mekem? Oli stap mekem ol samting ya we i nogud we i nogud, we i mekem mi mi aot long tabu haos ya blong mi, mi go longwe long hem. Mo bambae yu save luk ol samting we oli nogud moa winim hemia.”

title: Ezekiel 8:7
content: 7 Nao hem i tekem mi mi go long doa blong bigfala yad ya blong haos blong hem, mo mi luk wan hol we i gotru long bigfala stonwol blong yad ya.

title: Ezekiel 8:8
content: 8 Nao hem i talem long mi se, “Yu brekem stonwol long ples ya i gotru.” Nao mi brekem stonwol ya, mi gotru long hem, mo mi luk wan doa.

title: Ezekiel 8:9
content: 9 Nao hem i talem long mi se, “Yu go insaed, yu luk ol samting ya we i nogud we i nogud long fes blong mi we ol man ya oli stap mekem long ples ya.”

title: Ezekiel 8:10
content: 10 Nao mi go insaed, mi luk we olgeta ya oli droem ol pija olbaot long ol wol blong rum ya. Ol pija ya, i gat ol pija blong ol snek, mo ol anamol we oli doti long fes blong hem, mo ol pija blong ol narafala samting we ol laen* blong Isrel* oli stap mekem wosip long olgeta. Ol pija ya oli kavremapgud olgeta wol blong rum ya.

title: Ezekiel 8:11
content: 11 Mo i gat seventi lida blong ol laen blong Isrel oli stap long rum ya, mo Jahasania, we papa blong hem Safan, hem i wan long olgeta. Olgeta wanwan oli holem sensa* blong bonem insens,* mo smok blong insens ya i stap go antap.

title: Ezekiel 8:12
content: 12 Nao Hae God i talem long mi se, “?Yu luk samting ya we ol lida ya blong yufala oli stap mekem long haed? Olgeta ya wanwan oli stap mekem wosip long ol aedol blong olgeta insaed long ol haos blong olgeta we ol man oli no save luk olgeta. Oli stap mekem olsem from we oli stap talem se, ‘Hae God i no luk yumi ya. Hem i lego kantri blong yumi finis ya.’ ”

title: Ezekiel 8:13
content: 13 Nao bakegen, hem i talem long mi se, “Bambae yu save luk ol samting we oli stap mekem we oli nogud we i nogud moa, winim ol samting ya.”

title: Ezekiel 8:14
content: 14 Nao hem i tekem mi mi go long doa blong bigfala yad blong haos blong hem long saed i go long not, mo mi luk ol woman we oli stap krae long god ya Tamus we oli krae we i krae.

title: Ezekiel 8:15
content: 15 Nao hem i talem long mi se, “?Yu luk samting ya? Bambae yu luk ol samting we i nogud we i nogud moa winim hemia.”

title: Ezekiel 8:16
content: 16 Nao hem i tekem mi mi go insaed long smol yad ya bakegen, insaed long bigfala yad ya. Long ples ya i gat samwe long twanti faef man, oli stap stanap klosap long doa blong Rum we i Tabu, long medel blong olta mo vranda blong haos ya. Oli tanem baksaed i go long Rum ya we i Tabu, nao oli lukluk i go long is, oli bodaon, oli stap mekem wosip long san we i stap kam antap.

title: Ezekiel 8:17
content: 17 Nao hem i talem long mi se, “?Yu luk samting ya? Ol man Juda* ya oli stap mekem ol samting we i nogud we i nogud, stret long fes blong mi. Mo olgeta oli girap, oli stap mekem olgeta man oli stap faet agensem olgeta bakegen olbaot long kantri ya, we i mekem mi mi kros we mi kros moa. Be yu luk. Oli tanem baksaed long mi, oli stap spolem mi long fasin we i nogud we i nogud olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 8:18
content: 18 Nao from samting ya bambae oli luk paoa blong kros blong mi, mo bambae mi no save sevem laef blong olgeta, mo mi no save gat sore long olgeta nating. Bambae oli stap prea we oli singaot bigwan long mi, be mi no save lesin long olgeta nating.”

title: Ezekiel 9:1
content: 1 Nao long vison ya blong mi, mi harem we Hae God i singaot bigwan, i talem se, “Yufala we bambae i panisim ol man blong taon ya, yufala i karem ol samting blong faet blong yufala, yufala i kam.”

title: Ezekiel 9:2
content: 2 Nao wantaem nomo sikis man i kamtru long doa blong stonwol long bigfala yad ya blong haos* blong Hae God long saed i go long not. Olgeta oli karem ol samting blong faet blong olgeta. Mo i gat wan man blong raetemdaon ol samting, we hem i werem gudfala klos we oli wokem long linen,* i kam wetem olgeta, mo hem i gat wan paos we i gat ol samting blong raet i stap long hem, i hang long strap blong hem. Olgeta ya evriwan oli kam stanap long saed blong olta ya we oli wokem long bras.

title: Ezekiel 9:3
content: 3 Nao bigfala laet ya we i saen we i saen, we i soemaot we God blong yumi i stap, hem i aot long ol jerubim ya we i bin stap long hem, nao i muv i go long doa blong haos ya. Nao hem i talem long man ya blong raet se,

title: Ezekiel 9:4
content: 4 “Yu go long evri ples long taon ya, yu putum mak long fored blong olgeta man we oli trabol, oli stap harem nogud from ol samting nogud ya we ol narafala man ya oli stap mekem insaed long taon ya.”

title: Ezekiel 9:5
content: 5 Nao mi harem we Hae God i talem long ol sikis man ya se, “Yufala i folem man ya i go long taon ya, yufala i mas kilim olgeta man i ded. Yufala i no sore long olgeta, yufala i no livim wan i stap.

title: Ezekiel 9:6
content: 6 Ol olfala, mo ol yang man, mo ol yang woman, mo ol mama wetem ol pikinini blong olgeta, bambae yufala i kilim olgeta evriwan i ded. Be olgeta ya we oli gat mak long fored blong olgeta, bambae yufala i no kilim olgeta. Bambae yufala i stat blong kilim ol man long tabu haos ya blong mi.” Nao oli stat long ples ya, oli kilim ol lida we oli stap stanap klosap long doa blong Rum ya we i Tabu.

title: Ezekiel 9:7
content: 7 Nao Hae God i talem long olgeta se, “!Yufala i gohed! Yufala i mas mekem haos ya blong mi i no moa tabu long fes blong mi. Yufala i fulumap ol yad blong hem long ol dedbodi blong ol man ya, mo yufala i goaot blong kilim olgeta.” Nao olgeta oli gohed oli kilim olgeta man long taon ya.

title: Ezekiel 9:8
content: 8 Nao taem oli gohed oli stap kilim ol man ya, mi mi stap stanap mi wan long ples ya. Nao mi harem nogud, mi foldaon we fes blong mi i godaon long graon, mi singaot bigwan se, “?Hae God, Masta* blong mi, olsem wanem? Yu yu kros tumas long ol man Jerusalem,* mo bambae yu kilim olgeta man oli ded. ?Be bambae yu kilim ol laen* blong Isrel* evriwan oli ded?”

title: Ezekiel 9:9
content: 9 Nao hem i talem long mi se, “Ol laen blong Isrel oli mekem plante samting we i nogud we i nogud, we oli mas kasem panis from. Oli kilim man long evri ples long kantri ya, mo oli mekem Jerusalem i fulap long ol fasin nogud. Oli stap mekem olsem from we oli talem se mi mi lego kantri blong yufala finis, mo mi no save luk olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 9:10
content: 10 Be mi no save gat sore long olgeta, mi no save sevem olgeta, mo ol samting we oli bin mekem long ol narafala man, mi bambae mi givimbak sem samting long olgeta.”

title: Ezekiel 9:11
content: 11 Nao man ya blong raet i kambak long Hae God i talem se, “Olgeta samting ya we yu yu talem, mi mi mekem finis.”

title: Ezekiel 10:1
content: 1 Nao long vison ya, mi lukluk i go antap, mo mi luk wan samting olsem ruf we i raon, we i stap antap long hed blong ol jerubim ya, mo antap long olgeta i gat wan samting we i olsem jea blong king we oli wokem long flas ston ya safaea.*

title: Ezekiel 10:2
content: 2 Nao Hae God i talem long man ya blong raet we i werem klos ya we oli wokem long linen* se, “Yu go long medel blong ol wil ya we oli stap aninit long ol jerubim* ya, yu karem sam sakol faea we i laet, yu saksakem olgeta i go olbaot long taon ya.” Nao mi stap lukluk hem we i stap wokbaot i go.

title: Ezekiel 10:3
content: 3 Long taem ya, ol jerubim ya oli stap stanap long smol yad ya blong haos* blong Hae God, long saed i go long saot. Mo taem hem i stap go long medel blong ol wil blong olgeta, wan klaod i kam kavremapgud smol yad ya.

title: Ezekiel 10:4
content: 4 Mo bigfala laet ya we i saen we i saen we i soemaot we Hae God i stap, hem i aot long ol jerubim ya, nao i muv i go long doa blong haos blong Hae God. Nao klaod i kam kavremap haos ya, mo bigfala laet ya i saen i kam fulap long yad ya.

title: Ezekiel 10:5
content: 5 Nating we man i stap stanap long bigfala yad blong haos ya, we i longwe long Rum we i Tabu, be hem i save harem noes blong ol wing blong ol jerubim ya. Noes ya i olsem voes blong Hae God ya we i gat olgeta paoa.

title: Ezekiel 10:6
content: 6 Taem Hae God i talem long man ya blong raet, blong i go tekem faea we i stap long medel blong ol wil ya, man ya i go insaed long medel blong ol wil ya, i go stanap long saed blong wan long olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 10:7
content: 7 Nao wan long ol jerubim ya i pusum han blong hem i go long faea ya we i stap long medel blong olgeta, i karemaot sam sakol faea, i putum long han blong man ya. Mo man ya i tekem ol sakol ya, nao hem i aot i go.

title: Ezekiel 10:8
content: 8 Nao mi luk we ol jerubim ya oli gat han olsem han blong man i stap aninit long ol wing blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 10:9-10
content: 9-10 Mo mi luk we i gat fo wil we oli sem mak nomo, mo olgeta wil ya wanwan oli stap long saed blong ol jerubim ya wanwan. Ol wil ya oli saen gud olsem flas ston ya krisolaet.* Mo olgeta wanwan i gat narafala wil i gotru long hem we i mekem fokona long medel blong hem,

title: Ezekiel 10:11
content: 11 blong bambae ol wil ya oli save muv i go long ol fo saed we oli no save tanem olgeta. Ol jerubim ya oli save muv wantaem i go long weples we oli wantem go long hem, we oli no save tanem bodi blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 10:12
content: 12 Ol baksaed blong olgeta, mo ol han blong olgeta, mo ol wing blong olgeta, mo ol narafala haf blong ol bodi blong olgeta, mo ol wil blong olgeta tu, oli fulap long ae blong man.

title: Ezekiel 10:13
content: 13 Mo mi harem se nem blong ol wil ya, “Tantanem”.

title: Ezekiel 10:14
content: 14 Ol jerubim ya wanwan oli gat fo naranarafala fes. Olgeta fes ya, faswan, hem i fes blong bul, sekenwan, hem i fes blong man, mo namba tri, hem i fes blong laeon, mo namba fo, hem i fes blong bigfala pijin ya igel.*

title: Ezekiel 10:15
content: 15 Ol jerubim ya, hemia sem samting ya nomo we mi bin luk long Kebara Reva. Taem ol jerubim ya oli girap i go antap,

title: Ezekiel 10:16
content: 16 oli go wetem ol wil ya. Mo taem oli stretem ol wing blong olgeta, oli flae i go, be oli stap flae wetem ol wil ya.

title: Ezekiel 10:17
content: 17 Ol wil ya oli haf blong ol jerubim ya mo taem olgeta oli no muv, no oli flae i go, be ol wil ya oli go wetem olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 10:18
content: 18 Nao bigfala laet ya we i saen we i saen, we i soemaot we Hae God i stap, i aot long doa blong haos ya, i muv i go long ples blong hem antap long ol jerubim ya.

title: Ezekiel 10:19
content: 19 Taem mi stap lukluk yet, mi luk we ol jerubim ya oli stretem ol wing blong olgeta, oli flae i go antap wetem ol wil ya. Nao oli go stap smol long doa blong yad ya, long saed i go long is, mo laet ya i stap saen antap long olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 10:20
content: 20 Nao mi luksave we ol jerubim ya oli sem samting ya nomo we mi bin luk olgeta long Kebara Reva we oli stap aninit long bigfala jea ya blong God blong yumi.

title: Ezekiel 10:21
content: 21 Olgeta wanwan oli gat fo fes, mo fo wing, mo fo han blong man aninit long ol wing ya.

title: Ezekiel 10:22
content: 22 Ol fes blong olgeta oli sem fes ya nomo we mi bin luk long Kebara Reva. Mo olgeta oli gohed oli stap muv stret i go we oli no go olbaot.

title: Ezekiel 11:1
content: 1 Nao long vison ya blong mi, Spirit blong Hae God i leftemap mi mi go antap, i tekem mi mi go long doa blong yad blong haos* blong Hae God, long saed i go long is. Long ples ya, mi luk twanti faef man oli stap, mo long grup ya, i gat tu lida blong ol laen* blong Isrel* we nem blong tufala, Jahasania, we papa blong hem Asuru, mo Pelatia, we papa blong hem Benaea.

title: Ezekiel 11:2
content: 2 Nao Hae God i talem long mi se, “Man blong wol ya. Ol man ya oli stap mekem ol rabis plan, mo oli stap givim ol toktok blong givhan long ol man blong taon ya, be ol toktok ya blong olgeta i nogud we i nogud.

title: Ezekiel 11:3
content: 3 Oli stap talem se, ‘I no longtaem, bambae yumi stat wokem ol haos blong yumi bakegen. Taon ya i olsem wan sospen, mo yumi i olsem mit insaed long hem, be nating we i olsem, hem i stap blokem yumi blong faea i no save bonem yumi.’

title: Ezekiel 11:4
content: 4 Yu yu mas tok agens long olgeta ya.”

title: Ezekiel 11:5
content: 5 Nao Spirit blong Hae God i kam long mi, mo hem i talem long mi blong mi talemaot tok ya blong hem long ol man long taon ya, we i talem se, “!Olgeta! Mi mi save ol samting ya we yufala i stap tokbaot, mo ol samting ya we yufala i stap plan blong mekem.

title: Ezekiel 11:6
content: 6 Yufala i kilim plante man finis long taon ya, we i mekem ol rod ya oli fulap gud long ol dedman.

title: Ezekiel 11:7
content: 7 “Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta* blong yufala, mo mi talem long yufala se i tru we taon ya i wan sospen. ?Be mit we bambae i go long hem wanem? Ol man ya we yufala i stap kilim olgeta, hemia nao mit blong hem. Bambae yufala i no save stap long ples ya. Mi bambae mi sakemaot yufala i gowe long taon ya.

title: Ezekiel 11:8
content: 8 ?Weswe? ?Yufala i fraet long naef blong faet? Be bambae mi tekem ol man blong faet oli kam wetem ol naef blong faet blong olgeta, blong oli mekem faet long yufala.

title: Ezekiel 11:9
content: 9 Mo bambae mi tekemaot yufala i gowe long taon ya, mi putum yufala long han blong ol man blong narafala kantri. Mi mi talemaot finis, se bambae yufala i mas ded,

title: Ezekiel 11:10
content: 10 mo long taem ya, ol man ya bambae oli kilim yufala long faet, stret long mak blong graon blong kantri ya blong yufala. Nao bambae yufala evriwan i savegud we mi mi Hae God.

title: Ezekiel 11:11
content: 11 Taon ya bambae i no save blokem yufala olsem we sospen i blokem mit we i stap insaed long hem, from we mi bambae mi panisim yufala stret long mak blong graon blong kantri ya blong yufala.

title: Ezekiel 11:12
content: 12 Bambae yufala i savegud we mi mi Hae God, mo bambae yufala i save we taem yufala i stap obei long ol loa blong ol narafala kantri raonabaot long yufala, yufala i stap brekem ol loa blong mi, mo yufala i no obei long ol tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 11:13
content: 13 Nao mi luk se taem mi stap talemaot tok we Hae God i givim long mi, wantaem nomo, Pelatia i foldaon i ded olgeta. Nao mi mi foldaon we fes blong mi i go kasem graon blong mi prea, nao mi singaot bigwan se, “Hae God. Yu yu Masta blong mi. ?Weswe? ?Bambae yu yu kilim olgeta laen blong Isrel evriwan oli ded?”

title: Ezekiel 11:14
content: 14 Nao long vison ya, Hae God i talem long mi se,

title: Ezekiel 11:15
content: 15 “Man blong wol ya. Yu wetem ol narafala laen* blong Isrel* we yufala i stap wok slef* long Babilonia, ol laen blong yufala we oli stap long Jerusalem* oli stap tokbaot yufala. Oli stap talem se, ‘Ol man ya we oli stap wok slef long Babilonia oli stap longwe tumas blong mekem wosip long Hae God. Be yumi, Hae God i givim graon ya finis long yumi.’

title: Ezekiel 11:16
content: 16 Nao from samting ya, yu mas go talem long ol fren blong yu, we mi mi talem se, ‘Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta* blong yufala, mo mi nao mi sanemaot yufala blong yufala i kam stap wetem ol man long ol narafala kantri ya, mo mi mekem yufala i kam stap olbaot long ol kantri ya. Be mi mi stap yet wetem yufala.

title: Ezekiel 11:17
content: 17 Mi bambae mi tekemaot yufala long olgeta kantri ya we mi bin mekem yufala i go stap olbaot long olgeta, nao mi tekem yufala i kambak, mi givim kantri ya blong yufala i gobak long yufala bakegen.

title: Ezekiel 11:18
content: 18 Taem yufala i gobak long kantri ya blong yufala, bambae yufala i sakemaot olgeta aedol we yufala i save faenem long kantri ya, from we oli nogud we i nogud.

title: Ezekiel 11:19
content: 19 Bambae mi mekem laef blong yufala i niuwan, mi givim narafala tingting long yufala, blong yufala i mekem wosip long mi nomo. Mo bambae mi tekemaot ol rabis tingting long yufala we i stap mekem yufala i stronghed, mo mi givim gudfala tingting long yufala blong yufala i save obei long mi.

title: Ezekiel 11:20
content: 20 Nao long olgeta tingting blong yufala, bambae yufala i save holem ol loa blong mi, mo yufala i save obei long ol tok blong mi. Nao bambae yufala i man blong mi, mo mi mi God blong yufala.

title: Ezekiel 11:21
content: 21 Be bambae mi panisim ol man ya we oli wantem tumas blong mekem wosip long ol aedol. Ol aedol ya oli nogud we i nogud tumas, mo bambae mi panisim ol man ya from ol samting ya we oli stap mekem. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala, mo hemia tok blong mi.’ ”

title: Ezekiel 11:22
content: 22 Nao long vison* ya, mi luk we ol jerubim* ya oli aot, oli flae wetem ol wil blong olgeta, mo bigfala laet ya we i saen we i saen we i soemaot we God blong yumi i stap, hem i stap antap long olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 11:23
content: 23 Nao bigfala laet ya i gowe long taon ya, i go stap smol antap long bigfala hil ya long saed i go long is.

title: Ezekiel 11:24
content: 24 Nao Spirit blong God i leftemap mi mi go antap, i karem mi mi kambak long Babilonia long ol man ya we oli stap wok slef* long ples ya, nao vison ya i lus.

title: Ezekiel 11:25
content: 25 Nao olgeta samting ya we Hae God i soemaot long mi long vison ya, mi mi talemaot long olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 12:1
content: 1 Nao Hae God i talem long mi se,

title: Ezekiel 12:2
content: 2 “Man blong wol ya. Yu yu stap long ples ya long Babilonia, long medel blong ol man ya we oli girap oli stap agens long mi. Oli gat ae, be oli no save luk wan samting, mo oli gat sora, be oli no save harem wan samting, from we olgeta oli stap agensem mi.

title: Ezekiel 12:3
content: 3 “From samting ya, yu mas fulumap rere wan basket blong yu olsem man we i go wok slef* long narafala kantri, nao yu karem, yu stat wokbaot i go we i no tudak yet. Bambae yu mekem we olgeta man oli stap lukluk yu olsem we yu aot blong go long narafala ples. Maet olgeta ya oli save luksave we oli man blong agensem mi.

title: Ezekiel 12:4-5
content: 4-5 Taem i delaet yet, yu mekemrere basket blong yu we bambae olgeta oli save luk yu. Taem oli stap lukluk yu, yu brekem wan hol long wol blong haos blong yu, nao long sapa yu karem basket blong yu, yu gotru long hol ya, yu aot yu go olsem we yu stap ronwe blong go long narafala kantri. Yu mas mekem we olgeta oli save lukluk yu.

title: Ezekiel 12:6
content: 6 Nao taem i stap kam tudak, yu tekem basket blong yu long fes blong olgeta, mo yu kavremap fes blong yu blong yu no save lukluk ples, nao yu wokbaot i go. Nao samting ya we yu mekem bambae i wan saen blong wekemap ol laen* blong Isrel.*”

title: Ezekiel 12:7
content: 7 Nao mi mekem olsem we Hae God i talem long mi. Long dei ya, mi fulumap rere basket blong mi olsem man we i go wok slef long narafala kantri. Mo long sapa, taem i stat blong kam tudak, mi brekem wan hol long wol blong haos blong mi long han blong mi nomo, nao mi pastru long hem, mi go afsaed. Mo taem olgeta ya oli stap lukluk mi, mi girap, mi karem basket blong mi, nao mi stap wokbaot i go.

title: Ezekiel 12:8
content: 8 Nao long nekis dei, long moning, Hae God we i Masta* blong yumi i talem long mi se,

title: Ezekiel 12:9
content: 9 “Man blong wol ya. Naoia ol laen blong Isrel ya we oli stap agens long mi oli stap askem long yu se, ‘?Yu stap mekem wanem ya?’

title: Ezekiel 12:10
content: 10 Oraet, bambae yu go talem long olgeta, se samting ya we yu yu mekem, hem i blong man ya we i stap rul naoia long Jerusalem* we i wan pikinini blong king wetem ol laen blong Isrel we oli stap yet long taon ya.

title: Ezekiel 12:11
content: 11 Yu talem long olgeta, se samting ya we yu mekem, hem i wan saen blong samting we bambae i hapen long olgeta ya longwe. Bambae oli gowe long ples blong olgeta, oli go wok slef long narafala kantri.

title: Ezekiel 12:12
content: 12 Long wan naet, man ya we i stap rul long olgeta bambae i karem basket blong hem, i ronwe, i pastru long hol we bambae oli brekem long stonwol blong taon ya, mo i kavremap fes blong hem blong i no save lukluk ples, nao i wokbaot i go.

title: Ezekiel 12:13
content: 13 Be bambae mi putum trap blong mi, mi kasem hem. Nao bambae mi tekem hem i kam long taon ya Babilon, be bambae i no save luksave taon ya, mo bambae hem i stap long ples ya gogo i ded.

title: Ezekiel 12:14
content: 14 Mo bambae mi ronemaot ol haeman blong hem mo ol advaesa blong hem wetem ol gad blong hem oli go olbaot long evri ples, mo bambae ol man oli go lukaot olgeta blong kilim olgeta oli ded.

title: Ezekiel 12:15
content: 15 “Taem mi ronemaot olgeta oli go stap wetem ol man long ol narafala kantri, bambae oli savegud we mi mi Hae God.

title: Ezekiel 12:16
content: 16 Be bambae long taem blong faet, mo long taem we oli sot long kakae, mo long taem we rabis sik i stap spolem ol man, bambae mi letem sam long olgeta oli stap laef, be bambae oli no plante. Nao long ol narafala kantri ya, bambae oli save luksave we fasin blong olgeta i nogud we i nogud, mo bambae oli savegud we mi mi Hae God.”

title: Ezekiel 12:17
content: 17 Hae God i Masta* blong yumi, mo hem i talem long mi se,

title: Ezekiel 12:18
content: 18 “Man blong wol ya. Taem yu kakae mo yu dring, be yu mas mekem olsem we yu fraet, mo yu mas seksek we yu seksek.

title: Ezekiel 12:19
content: 19 Nao yu talem long olgeta laen* blong Isrel* evriwan, se saen ya we yu yu mekem i blong ol man Jerusalem* wetem olgeta we oli stap yet olbaot long kantri blong yufala. I gat taem i stap kam we sipos olgeta oli kakae mo oli dring, be bambae oli fraet, oli seksek we oli seksek. Bambae ol enemi oli tektekemaot olgeta samting long graon blong olgeta, from we olgeta ya oli stap brekem ol loa blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 12:20
content: 20 Ol taon we naoia oli fulap long ol man, bambae ol enemi oli spolem olgeta we oli flatemgud olgeta, mo bambae kantri ya blong yufala i stap nating nomo. Nao bambae yufala i savegud we mi mi Hae God.”

title: Ezekiel 12:21
content: 21 Hae God i Masta* blong yumi, mo hem i talem long mi se,

title: Ezekiel 12:22
content: 22 “Man blong wol ya. Naoia ol laen* blong Isrel* ya oli stap talem tok ya oltaem se, ‘Taem i stap go, be ol samting ya we ol profet oli stap talem, oli no kamtru nating.’

title: Ezekiel 12:23
content: 23 Be yu yu mas talemaot tingting blong mi long tok ya blong olgeta. Bambae mi mekem we tok ya i finis. Bambae oli no moa save taltalem tok ya bakegen long olgeta. Yu talem long olgeta we mi mi talem se, ‘Taem blong ol samting ya we ol profet oli stap talem, hem i stap kamtru nao.’

title: Ezekiel 12:24
content: 24 “Long ol laen blong Isrel, bambae i no moa gat man i save luk ol rabis vison, mo bambae i no moa gat man i save talem ol giaman toktok, se mi mi talem tok ya long hem.

title: Ezekiel 12:25
content: 25 Mi bambae mi tok long olgeta, mo wanem samting we mi talem i mas kamtru, i no moa gat wan samting i save blokem. Yufala ya we i stap girap agens long mi, long taem ya we yufala i stap laef yet, bambae mi mi mekem ol samting we mi talem long yufala oli kamtru. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 12:26
content: 26 Nao bakegen, hem i talem se,

title: Ezekiel 12:27
content: 27 “Olgeta ya oli stap ting se ol vison* we mi stap soemaot long yu, mo ol samting we yu stap talemaot se bambae oli kamtru, oli no save kamtru naoia, bambae i longtaem yet blong oli kamtru.

title: Ezekiel 12:28
content: 28 From samting ya, yu mas talemaot long olgeta we mi mi talem se bambae i no moa gat wan samting i save blokem tok blong mi. Ol samting we mi mi talem se bambae oli kamtru, oli mas kamtru. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 13:1
content: 1 Hae God i Masta* blong yumi, mo hem i talem long mi se,

title: Ezekiel 13:2
content: 2 “Man blong wol ya. Yu go tok agens long ol profet ya blong ol laen* blong Isrel* we oli stap talemaot ol tok we i kamaot long tingting blong olgeta nomo, be oli stap talem se i tok blong mi. Yu talem long olgeta blong oli lesin long tok blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 13:3
content: 3 “Mi mi talem se, ‘Ol profet. !Yufala i no gat hed nating! Bambae yufala i kasem panis we bambae yufala i ded from. Yufala i stap talemaot ol tingting blong yufala nomo, mo yufala i stap talem se yufala i luk ol samting long ol vison blong yufala, be yufala i stap giaman nomo.

title: Ezekiel 13:4
content: 4 Ol laen blong Isrel. Ol profet blong yufala oli olsem ol wael dog ya, we oli stap haed long ol stonwol blong taon we i brobrok. Oli no save givhan long yufala nating.

title: Ezekiel 13:5
content: 5 Ol Profet. Ol ples we stonwol blong taon ya i brobrok long hem, be yufala i no save gad nating long hem, mo yufala i no stanemap stonwol ya bakegen. Dei ya blong mi blong jajem ol man bambae i kam, be long taem ya, taem ol enemi oli kam blong faet long yufala, bambae ol stonwol ya oli no save blokem yufala nating.

title: Ezekiel 13:6
content: 6 Ol laen blong Isrel. Ol profet ya blong yufala oli stap luk ol rabis vison, mo oli stap giaman nomo se ol samting ya bambae oli kamtru. Oli talem se oli stap talemaot ol tok we mi mi givim long olgeta, be oli stap giaman nomo, mi mi no sanem olgeta. Be oli stap tingting se tok ya blong olgeta bambae i kamtru.

title: Ezekiel 13:7
content: 7 !Ol profet! Yufala i stap luk ol rabis vison, mo yufala i stap giaman nomo se ol samting we yufala i stap talem bambae oli kamtru. Yufala i stap talem se tok we yufala i stap talemaot i tok blong mi, be mi no givim tok ya long yufala.

title: Ezekiel 13:8
content: 8 Ol toktok blong yufala oli blong giaman nomo, mo ol vison* we yufala i stap luk oli rabis vison nomo. From ol samting ya, mi mi agensem yufala.

title: Ezekiel 13:9
content: 9 Yufala i stap giaman, mo ol tok blong yufala i stap mekem ol man oli gorong. From samting ya, mi bambae mi panisim yufala. Sipos ol lida blong ol man blong mi oli kam wanples blong mekem miting, bambae yufala i no moa save joen wetem olgeta. Ol nem blong yufala bambae oli no moa stap long lis blong ol man blong mi, mo bambae yufala i no save gobak long ples blong yufala bakegen samtaem. Nao bambae yufala i savegud we mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala.

title: Ezekiel 13:10
content: 10 “Olgeta. Ol profet ya oli stap lidim yufala i gorong. Olgeta oli stap talem se ol samting i oraet nomo, be ol samting oli no stret nating. I olsem we yufala i wokem wan stonwol we i no strong nating, mo ol profet ya oli kam, oli pentem long laem blong mekem i waet gud.

title: Ezekiel 13:11
content: 11 Be yufala i mas talem long olgeta, se stonwol ya bambae i foldaon. Bambae bigfala ren i kam, mo ol ston blong aes* bambae i folfoldaon long hem, mo bigfala win bambae i blu long hem,

title: Ezekiel 13:12
content: 12 nao bambae hem i brobrok, i folfoldaon, i kam nogud olgeta. Nao bambae yufala i stap talem long olgeta se, ‘!A! Laem ya i no givhan nating long stonwol ya.’ ”

title: Ezekiel 13:13
content: 13 Nao from samting ya, Hae God we i Masta blong yumi, hem i talem se, “Mi mi kros we mi kros. Bambae mi sanem strong win, mo bigfala ren, mo ol ston blong aes i kam blong spolem stonwol ya.

title: Ezekiel 13:14
content: 14 Mi bambae mi brebrekem stonwol ya, mi flatemgud, nao bambae mi livim fandesen blong hem i stap nating nomo olsem. Taem stonwol ya i brobrok i foldaon, bambae i kilim yufala evriwan i ded. Nao bambae yufala evriwan i savegud we mi mi Hae God.

title: Ezekiel 13:15
content: 15 “Ol profet ya mo stonwol ya we oli pentem long laem, bambae oli harem paoa blong kros blong mi. Nao mi bambae mi talemaot long yufala, se stonwol ya i brobrok finis, mo ol profet ya evriwan oli ded finis.

title: Ezekiel 13:16
content: 16 Hemia olgeta ya we oli stap talem long ol man Jerusalem,* se evri samting i oraet nomo, be ol samting oli no stret nating. Mi mi Hae God mi Masta blong yufala, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 13:17
content: 17 Hae God i Masta* blong yumi, mo hem i talem long mi se, “Man blong wol ya. Naoia yu mas tok agens long ol woman ples blong yu we oli profet. Olgeta oli stap talemaot ol samting, se bambae oli kamtru long fiuja, be hemia tingting blong olgeta nomo.

title: Ezekiel 13:18
content: 18 Yu talemaot long olgeta we mi mi talem se, ‘Yufala ol woman, bambae yufala i kasem panis we bambae yufala i ded from. Yufala i stap somap ol kaliko blong fasem long han blong mekem majik, blong man i save yusum, mo yufala i stap somap ol angkejif blong majik, we man i save putum long hed blong hem, blong hem i gat paoa blong spolem laef blong narafala man. Yufala i wantem se yufala i gat paoa blong holem laef blong ol man blong mi, blong yufala i save kilim sam i ded, mo yufala i save holem sam i stap laef, blong yufala i winim mane long fasin ya.

title: Ezekiel 13:19
content: 19 Yufala i wantem kasem kakae blong yufala, be yufala i stap spolem nem blong mi nomo long fes blong ol man blong mi. Yufala i kilim ol man we oli no blong ded, mo olgeta we i stret blong oli ded, yufala i holem olgeta oli stap laef. Yufala i stap giaman long ol man blong mi, nao oli stap bilif long yufala.

title: Ezekiel 13:20
content: 20 “Mi mi no wantem nating ol kaliko ya we yufala i stap yusum blong traem holem paoa blong laef mo paoa blong ded. Bambae mi teremaot ol kaliko ya i gowe long han blong yufala, nao ol man ya we yufala i holem olgeta, yufala i stap bos long laef blong olgeta, mi bambae mi letem olgeta oli go fri.

title: Ezekiel 13:21
content: 21 Mo bambae mi teremaot ol angkejif ya, nao mi letem ol man blong mi oli ronwe long paoa blong yufala we bambae yufala i no moa save holem olgeta bakegen samtaem. Nao bambae yufala i savegud we mi mi Hae God.

title: Ezekiel 13:22
content: 22 “Ol man ya we mi mi no wantem spolem olgeta, yufala i stap giaman long olgeta, nao yufala i mekem tingting blong olgeta i foldaon. Mo yufala i stap givhan long ol man nogud, blong oli gohed long ol rabis fasin blong olgeta, blong oli no sevem laef blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 13:23
content: 23 Nao from samting ya, i stat naoia, ol rabis vison ya blong yufala, mo ol giaman toktok blong yufala we yufala i stap talem se bambae oli kamtru, bambae oli finis olgeta. Bambae mi sevem ol man blong mi, mi tekemaot olgeta i gowe long han blong yufala, blong bambae yufala i savegud we mi mi Hae God.”

title: Ezekiel 14:1
content: 1 Nao i gat sam lida blong ol laen* blong Isrel* oli kam sidaon long fes blong mi blong faenemaot tingting blong Hae God we i Masta* blong yumi.

title: Ezekiel 14:2
content: 2 Be hem i talem long mi se,

title: Ezekiel 14:3
content: 3 “Man blong wol ya. Ol man ya oli givim laef blong olgeta finis long ol aedol, mo ol aedol ya oli lidim olgeta oli foldaon long sin. Olgeta oli no gat raet nating blong kam blong traem faenemaot sam samting long mi.

title: Ezekiel 14:4
content: 4 “Nao from samting ya, yu mas talemaot long olgeta we mi mi talem se, ‘Ol laen blong Isrel. Yufala i stap givim laef blong yufala long ol aedol, mo yufala i letem ol aedol ya oli lidim yufala i foldaon long sin. Be sipos yufala i kam luk wan profet blong mi blong faenemaot wan samting, mi bambae mi givim ansa long yufala. Ansa ya bambae i stret blong yufala i kasem, from we yufala i stap mekem wosip long plante aedol.

title: Ezekiel 14:5
content: 5 Be long ansa ya blong mi, mi wantem tanem tingting blong yufala blong yufala i kambak long mi, yufala i putum tingting blong yufala i stap strong long mi bakegen.’

title: Ezekiel 14:6
content: 6 “Nao from samting ya, yu mas talemaot long olgeta ya we mi mi talem se, ‘Yufala i mas tanem tingting blong yufala, yufala i mas lego olgeta aedol ya blong yufala, mo yufala i mas tanem baksaed long olgeta. Ol aedol ya oli nogud we i nogud long fes blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 14:7
content: 7 “ ‘Sipos wan long yufala, no wan man blong narafala kantri we i stap wetem yufala, i tanem baksaed long mi, nao i mekem wosip long ol aedol, nao biaen i kam luk wan profet blong faenemaot wan samting long mi, mi bambae mi givim ansa long hem

title: Ezekiel 14:8
content: 8 blong meksave hem. Long fasin ya, bambae mi mekem hem i kam wan saen blong wonem yufala evriwan. Bambae mi tekemaot hem i gowe long yufala, blong bambae yufala i savegud we mi mi Hae God.

title: Ezekiel 14:9
content: 9 “ ‘Sipos ol man oli trikim wan profet, nao hem i giaman, i givim ansa long olgeta, be hemia from we mi nao mi mekem i kamtru olsem. Mo bambae mi tekemaot hem long yufala, mi kilim hem i ded.

title: Ezekiel 14:10
content: 10 Bambae profet ya wetem man ya we i go luk hem blong faenemaot wan samting long hem, tufala tugeta bambae i kasem sem panis.

title: Ezekiel 14:11
content: 11 Bambae mi mekem olsem blong yufala i no lego mi, mo blong yufala i no moa mekem ol samting nogud bakegen blong mekem yufala i doti long fes blong mi. Mi wantem we yufala i man blong mi nomo, mo mi nomo mi God blong yufala. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala, mo hemia tok blong mi.’ ”

title: Ezekiel 14:12
content: 12 Nao Hae God i talem long mi se,

title: Ezekiel 14:13
content: 13 “Man blong wol ya. Sipos ol man blong wan kantri oli mekem sin agens long mi we tingting blong olgeta i no moa stap strong long mi, mi bambae mi leftemap han blong mi, mi spolem ol kakae blong olgeta. Bambae mi mekem olgeta oli kasem wan hadtaem we oli sot long kakae, mo bambae oli hanggri gogo oli ded, mo ol anamol blong olgeta tu bambae oli ded.

title: Ezekiel 14:14
content: 14 Nating we sipos trifala man ya, Noa mo Daniel mo Job, trifala i stap long taem ya, be gudfala fasin blong trifala bambae i sevem laef blong trifala nomo. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta* blong yufala, mo hemia tok blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 14:15-16
content: 15-16 “Sipos mi sanem ol wael anamol oli kam blong kilim olgeta, mo olbaot long kantri ya, ol man oli no save pas long hem, from we oli fraet long ol wael anamol ya, bambae kantri ya i stap nating nomo. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala, mo mi laef, mi stap we mi stap. Mo naoia, mi mi promes long nem blong mi, se nating we sipos trifala man ya i stap long ples ya, be bambae trifala i no save sevem wan man nating, trifala i save sevem laef blong trifala nomo. Mo sipos ol pikinini blong trifala i stap, be bambae trifala i no save sevem olgeta tu.

title: Ezekiel 14:17
content: 17 “Mo sipos mi tekem faet i kam long kantri ya, mo ol enemi oli kilim olgeta man mo olgeta anamol evriwan i ded, bambae kantri ya i stap nating nomo.

title: Ezekiel 14:18
content: 18 Mo mi mi promes long nem blong mi, se nating we sipos trifala ya i stap long ples ya, be bambae trifala i no save sevem wan man nating, trifala i save sevem laef blong trifala nomo. Mo sipos ol pikinini blong trifala i stap, be bambae trifala i no save sevem olgeta tu.

title: Ezekiel 14:19
content: 19 “Mo sipos mi sanem wan rabis sik i kam kavremap kantri ya, nao sik ya i kilim olgeta man mo olgeta anamol oli ded from we mi mi kros tumas, bambae kantri ya i stap nating nomo.

title: Ezekiel 14:20
content: 20 Mo mi mi promes long nem blong mi, se nating we sipos trifala ya i stap long ples ya, be bambae trifala i no save sevem wan man nating, stret fasin blong trifala i save sevem laef blong trifala nomo. Mo sipos ol pikinini blong trifala i stap, be bambae trifala i no save sevem olgeta tu.”

title: Ezekiel 14:21
content: 21 Hae God i Masta blong yumi, mo hem i talem se, “Ol laen* blong Isrel.* I gat fo panis we oli nogud we i nogud we mi bambae mi sanem i kam long Jerusalem.* Ol panis ya, i gat faet, mo hadtaem we ol man bambae oli sot long kakae, mo ol wael anamol we bambae oli kilim ol man, mo rabis sik we bambae ol man oli ded from. Bambae mi sanem ol fo samting ya blong kilim olgeta man mo olgeta anamol oli ded.

title: Ezekiel 14:22
content: 22 Sipos sam man oli stap laef, mo oli sevem ol pikinini blong olgeta, nao oli kam luk yufala long ples ya we yufala i stap wok slef* long hem, i gud yufala i luklukgud fasin blong olgeta. Bambae yufala i save luk we olgeta oli man nogud tru, nao bambae yufala i bilif se panis we mi stap givim long Jerusalem i stret nomo blong hem i kasem.

title: Ezekiel 14:23
content: 23 Nao bambae yufala i save luksave se olgeta samting we mi mi mekem, mi mekem from ol rabis fasin ya blong olgeta, mo i stret nomo blong mi mekem olsem. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 15:1
content: 1 Nao Hae God i toktok long mi long wan vison,

title: Ezekiel 15:2
content: 2 i talem se, “Man blong wol ya. ?Yu ting se rop ya grep* i gud moa i winim wud? ?Yu ting se han blong rop ya i gud moa i winim ol naranarafala wud long bus?

title: Ezekiel 15:3
content: 3 Yu no save yusum blong wokem wan samting long hem. Rop ya i no strong. Yu no save wokem huk long hem blong hangem wan samting long hem.

title: Ezekiel 15:4
content: 4 ?Sipos faea i kakae tufala en blong hem, mo medel blong hem nomo i stap we faea i mekem i blak finis, yu ting se yu save yusum blong wokem wan gudfala samting long hem? Hem i gud blong bonem nomo.

title: Ezekiel 15:5
content: 5 Nating we faea i no bonem yet, be i nogud blong wokem wan samting long hem. Mo taem we faea i bonem finis, i moa nogud olgeta.”

title: Ezekiel 15:6
content: 6 Hae God i Masta* blong yumi mo hem i talem se, “Olsem we yufala i stap tekem ol rop blong grep long bus blong mekem faeawud long hem, long sem fasin bambae mi tekem ol man ya we oli stap long Jerusalem,*

title: Ezekiel 15:7
content: 7 nao bambae mi panisim olgeta. Oli bin ronwe finis long wan faea, be naoia bambae faea i bonem olgeta evriwan i ded. Mo sipos mi panisim olgeta, bambae yufala i savegud we mi mi Hae God.

title: Ezekiel 15:8
content: 8 Tingting blong olgeta i no moa stap strong long mi, oli tanem baksaed long mi, mo from samting ya, bambae mi mekem kantri blong olgeta i stap nating nomo. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 16:1
content: 1 Hae God i Masta* blong yumi, mo hem i toktok long mi long wan vison bakegen, i talem se,

title: Ezekiel 16:2
content: 2 “Man blong wol ya. Yu mas talemaot ol fasin ya long ol man long taon ya Jerusalem* we oli stap mekem we i nogud we i nogud.

title: Ezekiel 16:3
content: 3 Yu mas talemaot ol tok blong mi long taon ya, we mi mi talem se, ‘Jerusalem. Yu yu olsem wan smol gel we yu bon long kantri ya Kenan.* Papa mo mama blong yu tufala i kamaot long ol laen we oli man blong mekem nogud. Papa blong yu i laen blong Amoro,* mo mama blong yu i laen blong Het.

title: Ezekiel 16:4
content: 4 Mo long taem ya we yu yu bon, i no gat man i katem nambuton blong yu, mo i no gat man i wasem yu, mo i ravem sol long bodi blong yu, mo i kavremap yu long kaliko.

title: Ezekiel 16:5
content: 5 Long taem ya i no gat man i gat sore long yu blong mekem ol samting ya long yu. Taem we yu yu bon, i no gat man i laekem yu nating. Oli sakem yu yu stap afsaed nomo long open ples.

title: Ezekiel 16:6
content: 6 “Nao taem mi pas long ples ya, mi luk we yu yu stap harem nogud, yu stap muvmuv long blad ya we yu yu bon long hem. Blad ya i kavremap yu, be mi no letem yu yu ded.

title: Ezekiel 16:7
content: 7 Mi mekem yu yu gruap olsem wan smol tri we i gru gud. Yu yu gru, yu kam bigwan, yu kam strong, mo yu kam wan yang gel we yu naes we yu naes, be yu no gat klos blong blokem yu.

title: Ezekiel 16:8
content: 8 “Nao wan taem, mi pas long ples ya bakegen, mo mi luk we yu yu naf blong mared. Nao mi kavremap bodi blong yu long wan kot blong mi, mo mi promes se bambae mi lavem yu. Nao mi mekem promes wetem yu blong mared long yu, mo yu yu kam woman blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 16:9
content: 9 “Nao mi tekem wota, mi wasemaot blad we yu yu bon long hem i gowe long yu, mo mi tekem olifoel,* mi ravem bodi blong yu long hem.

title: Ezekiel 16:10
content: 10 Nao mi tekem klos we oli flasemgud, mi putum long yu, mo mi tekem sus we oli wokem long skin blong anamol we i beswan, mi givim long yu. Mo mi tekem kaliko ya linen* we i beswan, mi fasem hed blong yu long hem, mo mi tekem kot we oli wokem long silik, mi putum long yu.

title: Ezekiel 16:11
content: 11 Nao mi flasem yu long ol gudgudfala samting we oli wokem long ol flas ston, mo mi tekem ol strap blong han we oli flas gud, nao mi putum long han blong yu, mo mi hangem jen long nek blong yu.

title: Ezekiel 16:12
content: 12 Mo mi tekem wan ring, mi putum long nus blong yu, mo mi putum iaring long sora blong yu, mo mi tekem wan hat blong kwin we i flas gud, nao mi putum long hed blong yu.

title: Ezekiel 16:13
content: 13 Nao from samting ya, yu yu gat ol gudgudfala samting we oli wokem long gol mo silva blong flasem yu, mo oltaem yu stap putum ol klos we oli wokem long linen we i beswan, mo silik we oli flasemgud. Mo yu gat ol gudgudfala kakae blong yu. Yu gat bred we oli wokem long flaoa we i beswan, mo hani,* mo olifoel. Nao yu kam wan kwin we yu naes we yu naes.

title: Ezekiel 16:14
content: 14 Mo from we yu naes tumas, olgeta man long ol narafala kantri oli harem nius blong yu. Be mi nomo mi mekem yu yu naes olsem.

title: Ezekiel 16:15
content: 15 “Nao from we yu yu naes olsem, mo olgeta man oli savegud yu, yu girap, yu slip wetem ol man we oli stap kam long yu.

title: Ezekiel 16:16
content: 16 Mo yu stap yusum ol klos blong yu blong flasem ol ples we yu stap mekem wosip long hem. Mo yu mekem yu yu olsem woman blong rod nomo, yu stap slip wetem ol man we oli stap kam long yu.

title: Ezekiel 16:17
content: 17 Nao yu tekem ol gudgudfala samting ya we oli wokem long silva mo long gol we mi mi givim long yu, nao yu yusum blong mekem ol aedol we oli pija blong man, mo yu stap mekem i krangke long olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 16:18
content: 18 Yu stap tekem ol flas klos ya we mi givim long yu, yu flasem ol aedol ya long hem, mo yu tekem olifoel mo insens* we mi givim long yu, yu givim i go long olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 16:19
content: 19 Mi givim flaoa long yu we i beswan, mo olifoel, mo hani, blong i kakae blong yu, be yu girap, yu go mekem sakrefaes long hem long ol aedol ya, blong yu mekem olgeta oli glad long yu.

title: Ezekiel 16:20
content: 20 “Ol pikinini boe blong mi, mo ol dota blong mi, we yu yu bonem olgeta, be yu girap, yu stap kilim olgeta, yu mekem sakrefaes long olgeta i go long ol aedol ya. Fasin ya blong yu we tingting blong yu i no moa stap strong long mi, yu tanem baksaed long mi, hem i nogud. ?Be olsem wanem? ?Hemia i no naf yet?

title: Ezekiel 16:21
content: 21 Yu yu girap, yu tekem ol pikinini ya blong mi, yu kilim olgeta, yu bonem olgeta blong mekem sakrefaes long ol aedol ya.

title: Ezekiel 16:22
content: 22 Oltaem long laef blong yu, yu stap mekem i krangke olsem woman blong rod, be neva yu tingbaot taem ya bifo we yu yu pikinini yet, we yu stap neked, mo yu stap swim long blad ya we yu yu bon long hem. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yu, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 16:23
content: 23 Mo long vison ya, Hae God we i Masta* blong yumi, hem i gohed, i tok long taon ya, i talem se, “Jerusalem.* !Sore tumas long yu! Yu bambae yu kasem panis we bambae yu ded from. Yu stap mekem ol samting nogud ya, be biaen yu girap yu go moa.

title: Ezekiel 16:24
content: 24 Long saed blong olgeta rod, yu putumap ol ples blong mekem wosip long ol aedol ya, mo yu mekem fasin blong woman blong rod long olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 16:25
content: 25 Yu yu naes, be long ol ples ya, yu stap spolem yu nomo long fasin ya we yu stap singaot long ol man we oli stap pas long rod, blong oli kam slip wetem yu. Mo oltaem fasin ya blong yu i stap kam mowas olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 16:26
content: 26 Ol man Ijip oli wantem woman tumas, mo yu girap, yu letem olgeta oli kam fren long yu, mo oli stap slip wetem yu, nao long rabis fasin ya, yu mekem mi mi kros we mi kros.

title: Ezekiel 16:27
content: 27 “Naoia mi leftemap han blong mi blong mi panisim yu, mi tekemaot haf long ol gudgudfala samting we mi givim long yu fastaem. Mi putum yu finis long han blong ol man Filistia we oli no laekem yu nating, oli agens long yu, mo oli ting rabis long yu from ol fasin ya blong yu we i nogud we i nogud we yu stap slip wetem ol man olbaot.

title: Ezekiel 16:28
content: 28 “Yu yu stap slip wetem ol man ya, be yu harem se i no naf yet, nao from samting ya, yu stap resis biaen long ol man Asiria. Olgeta ya oli stap slip wetem yu, be yu harem se hemia i no naf yet.

title: Ezekiel 16:29
content: 29 Nao yu gohed long fasin ya, yu stap slip wetem ol bisnesman blong Babilonia tu, be yu harem se hemia tu i no naf yet.”

title: Ezekiel 16:30
content: 30 Mo Hae God i gohed, i talem se, “Ol samting ya we yu yu stap mekem, yu no sem long hem nating. Yu yu olsem woman blong rod we i no save sem nating.

title: Ezekiel 16:31
content: 31 Long olgeta rod, yu putumap ol ples blong mekem wosip long ol aedol, mo blong mekem fasin blong woman blong rod long olgeta. Be yu yu no mekem blong winim mane olsem ol narafala woman blong rod.

title: Ezekiel 16:32
content: 32 Yu yu olsem wan woman we i mekem i krangke wetem ol narafala man. Yu yu girap, yu go stap slip wetem ol man blong ol narafala kantri we yu no save olgeta nating.

title: Ezekiel 16:33
content: 33 Ol narafala woman blong rod, ol man oli stap pem olgeta blong go slip wetem olgeta, be yu yu stap singaot ol man blong evri ples we yu wantem olgeta, mo yu stap givim presen long olgeta blong pem olgeta blong oli kam slip wetem yu.

title: Ezekiel 16:34
content: 34 I no gat man i fosem yu blong yu kam wan woman blong rod. Mo ol man oli no pem yu, yu yu pem olgeta. !Yu yu wan woman we i narafala olgeta!”

title: Ezekiel 16:35-36
content: 35-36 Mo long vison ya, Hae God we i Masta* blong yumi, hem i talem long taon ya bakegen se, “Jerusalem.* Yu mas lesin long tok blong mi. Yu yu woman blong rod stret. Oltaem yu stap tekemaot ol klos blong yu, blong slip wetem ol man we yu wantem olgeta.
