Yu stap givim yu long ol aedol ya we oli nogud we i nogud, mo yu stap kilim ol pikinini blong yu, blong mekem sakrefaes long olgeta long ol aedol ya.

title: Ezekiel 16:37
content: 37 From samting ya, olgeta man ya we yu bin slip wetem olgeta, bambae mi tekem olgeta oli kam wanples. Hemia olgeta we yu wantem olgeta wetem olgeta we yu no wantem olgeta nating. Bambae mi tekem olgeta oli kam stanap raon long yu, nao bambae mi tektekemaot ol klos blong yu, mi letem olgeta oli luk yu we yu stap neked.

title: Ezekiel 16:38
content: 38 Mo bambae mi jajem yu, se yu mas kasem sem panis olsem woman we i stap go slip wetem narafala man bambae i kasem, mo woman we i kilim pikinini i ded bambae i kasem. Bambae mi kilim yu yu ded, from we fasin blong yu i mekem mi mi kros we mi kros.

title: Ezekiel 16:39
content: 39 Bambae mi putum yu long han blong ol man ya we yu wantem olgeta, mo bambae oli brebrekem ol ples ya we yu stap mekem fasin blong woman blong rod long hem, mo yu stap mekem wosip long ol aedol long hem. Bambae oli tekemaot ol klos blong yu, mo ol gudgudfala samting blong yu we oli wokem long ol flas ston, nao oli livim yu yu stap neked nomo.

title: Ezekiel 16:40
content: 40 “Bambae olgeta ya oli mekem ol man oli kros, oli girap, oli stonem yu, nao oli katkatem yu long ol smosmol pis long ol naef blong faet blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 16:41
content: 41 Mo bambae oli bonemdaon ol haos blong yu, nao bambae oli mekem ol narafala woman oli kam wanples, oli stap lukluk yu we mi stap panisim yu. Bambae mi mekem yu yu no moa mekem fasin blong woman blong rod, mo yu no moa stap givim presen long ol man ya we yu wantem olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 16:42
content: 42 Nao bambae mi harem gud, mi stap kwaet, mo kros blong mi bambae i finis. Bambae mi no moa kros, mo mi no moa jalus bakegen.

title: Ezekiel 16:43
content: 43 Fasin ya we mi mi lukaot gud long yu taem yu yu yangfala yet, yu yu fogetem finis, nao yu mekem mi mi kros from ol samting ya we yu stap mekem. Nao from samting ya, bambae mi mekem yu yu kasem panis. Yu yu stap mekem ol samting ya we oli nogud we i nogud. Mo antap long ol samting ya, yu girap yu stap go slip wetem ol narafala man. !Fasin ya i nogud we i nogud! Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yu, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 16:44
content: 44 Nao long vison ya, Hae God i toktok bakegen, i talem se, “Jerusalem.* Bambae olgeta man oli stap yusum tok ya blong tokbaot yu se, ‘Gel ya i folem fasin blong mama blong hem.’

title: Ezekiel 16:45
content: 45 Yu yu olsem mama blong yu stret, we i no laekem man blong hem mo i no laekem ol pikinini blong hem tu. Mo yu olsem tufala sista blong yu tu, we tufala i no laekem nating tufala man blong tufala wetem ol pikinini blong tufala. Yu wetem tufala sista blong yu, mama blong yutrifala i wan laen blong Het, mo papa blong yutrifala i wan laen blong Amoro.*

title: Ezekiel 16:46
content: 46 “Fasbon sista blong yu, taon ya Sameria* wetem ol vilej raonabaot long hem, we oli stap long not. Mo lasbon sista blong yu, taon ya Sodom wetem ol vilej raonabaot long hem, we oli stap long saot.

title: Ezekiel 16:47
content: 47 Yu yu stap folem ol rod blong tufala, mo yu stap biaen long ol fasin blong tufala we i nogud we i nogud. Be yu yu harem se hemia i no naf yet. Biaen i no longtaem yu yu go moa, nao long ol samting ya we yu stap mekem, fasin blong yu i kam mowas i winim tufala.

title: Ezekiel 16:48
content: 48 “Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta* blong yufala, mo mi laef, mi stap we mi stap. Mo naoia, mi mi talem stret long yu, se long nem blong mi, sista ya blong yu, Sodom wetem ol vilej blong hem, neva oli mekem ol fasin nogud olsem we yu wetem ol vilej blong yu, yufala i stap mekem.

title: Ezekiel 16:49
content: 49 Bifo, taon ya wetem ol vilej blong hem oli praod tumas, oli kakae gud from we oli gat plante kakae, mo oli stap gud nomo, be oli no stap tingbaot ol narafala man, mo oli no stap lukaot gud long ol puaman.

title: Ezekiel 16:50
content: 50 Oli flas, mo oli stronghed, mo ol samting we oli stap mekem i nogud we i nogud we mi mi no laekem nating, nao mi spolem olgeta we mi flatemgud olgeta. Yu yu savegud stori blong hem.

title: Ezekiel 16:51
content: 51 “Ol sin we Sameria i mekem i no kasem haf blong ol sin blong yu nating. Yu yu mekem ol samting we i nogud moa, i winim ol samting we hem i mekem. Taem mi makem yu wetem tufala sista ya blong yu, mi luk olsem we tufala i stret nomo, be yu yu nogud we yu nogud olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 16:52
content: 52 Mo naoia, yu yu mas sem from ol samting ya. Ol sin blong yu oli plante tumas, i winim ol sin blong tufala sista ya blong yu. Mo from samting ya, mi mi luk olsem we tufala i stret nomo long fes blong mi. Naoia fes blong yu i mas kam nogud, from we taem mi skelem fasin nogud blong yutrifala, mi luk se fasin blong tufala sista ya blong yu i stret nomo.”

title: Ezekiel 16:53
content: 53 Nao long vison ya, Hae God i toktok bakegen, i talem se, “Bambae mi mekem Sodom wetem ol vilej blong hem, mo Sameria* wetem ol vilej blong hem, oli gat gudfala laef bakegen, oli gohed gud. Mo yu tu, bambae mi mekem yu yu gat gudfala laef, mo yu save gohed gud olsem.

title: Ezekiel 16:54
content: 54 Be fastaem, yu bambae yu sem gud, mo fasin ya bambae i mekem tufala ya i harem gud lelebet.

title: Ezekiel 16:55
content: 55 Nao Sodom wetem ol vilej blong hem, mo Sameria wetem ol vilej blong hem, mo yu tu wetem ol vilej blong yu, yufala evriwan bambae i kam gud bakegen olsem bifo.

title: Ezekiel 16:56-57
content: 56-57 Long taem ya bifo we yu yu stap praod, mo ol rabis fasin blong yu i no kamaot long klia ples yet, yu yu stap jikim Sodom tumas. Be naoia yu luk. Yu yu olsem hem nomo. Edom, mo Filistia, mo ol narafala kantri raonabaot long yu we oli no laekem yu nating, olgeta evriwan oli stap jikim yu long sem fasin.

title: Ezekiel 16:58
content: 58 Yu bambae yu harem nogud from ol rabis fasin ya blong yu, mo ol samting ya we yu yu stap mekem we oli nogud we i nogud olgeta. Mi mi Hae God, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 16:59
content: 59 Mo long vison ya, Hae God we i Masta* blong yumi, hem i talem se, “Jerusalem.* Mi bambae mi panisim yu long mak we i stret blong yu yu kasem, from we yu no holem ol promes* blong yu, mo yu brekem promes ya we mi bin mekem wetem yu.

title: Ezekiel 16:60
content: 60 Be promes we mi bin mekem wetem yu taem yu yangfala yet, mi bambae mi holem, mo bambae mi mekem wan narafala promes wetem yu, we bambae i stap oltaem gogo i no save finis.

title: Ezekiel 16:61
content: 61 Taem yu tekem olfala sista blong yu wetem yangfala sista blong yu, tufala i kambak, bambae yu tingbaot ol samting ya we yu yu mekem, nao bambae yu sem from. Mo nating we tufala i no haf blong promes blong mi wetem yu fastaem, be bambae mi letem tufala i kam dota blong yu.

title: Ezekiel 16:62
content: 62 Bambae mi mekem promes ya blong mi wetem yu i kam niuwan bakegen, nao bambae yu savegud we mi mi Hae God.

title: Ezekiel 16:63
content: 63 Mi bambae mi fogivim yu, mi tekemaot olgeta sin blong yu, be taem yu tingbaot olgeta, bambae yu sem tumas from, nao yu stap kwaet. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yu, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 17:1
content: 1 Hae God i Masta* blong yumi, mo hem i toktok long mi bakegen,

title: Ezekiel 17:2
content: 2 i talem se, “Man blong wol ya. Yu talem wan parabol long ol laen* blong Isrel,*

title: Ezekiel 17:3
content: 3 blong mekem olgeta oli save wanem samting mi mi stap talem long olgeta. Parabol ya i olsem. I gat wan bigfala pijin ya igel* we i bigwan we i bigwan, mo gras blong hem i gat plante kala long hem. Tufala wing blong hem i bigbigwan, mo taem hem i stretem tufala, tufala i longfala we i longfala. Nao hem i flae i go antap long ol bigfala hil blong Lebanon, i brekem top blong wan sida,*

title: Ezekiel 17:4
content: 4 nao i karem i go long wan kantri we ol man blong hem oli wokem plante bisnes long hem, mo i putum long wan taon blong ol bisnesman.

title: Ezekiel 17:5
content: 5 Nao hem i pulumaot wan smol gru blong rop ya grep* long kantri ya Juda,* i go planem long wan ples we graon blong hem i gud, mo oltaem i gat wota blong mekem i gru gud.

title: Ezekiel 17:6
content: 6 Nao grep ya i gru, i kam bigfala, be i no go antap tumas. Hem i kavremap bigfala ples, mo ol han blong hem oli poen i go antap long bigfala igel ya, mo ol rus blong hem oli godaon we i godaon olgeta. Grep ya i gat plante han long hem we oli fulap gud long lif blong hem.

title: Ezekiel 17:7
content: 7 “Nao i gat wan narafala igel bakegen we i bigwan we i bigwan, mo gras blong hem i fulap, mo tufala wing blong hem i bigbigwan. Nao ol rus blong grep ya oli poen i go stret long igel ya, mo ol top blong hem tu oli poen i go stret long hem, from we hem i ting se maet igel ya i save givim moa wota long hem, i winim we hem i stap kasem long ples ya we i stap gru long hem.

title: Ezekiel 17:8
content: 8 Be grep ya, fas igel i planem finis long gudfala graon ya we i gat plante wota long hem, blong bambae i save kam wan nambawan grep, we i save gat plante han blong hem, mo i save karem plante frut.

title: Ezekiel 17:9
content: 9 “Mo yu talem long olgeta we mi mi talem se, ‘?Olsem wanem? ?Bambae grep ya i gru? !Nogat! Bambae fas igel ya i pulumaot grep ya, mo i tektekemaot ol frut blong hem, nao i brebrekem ol han blong hem, i livim olgeta blong oli drae. Bambae hem i no nidim paoa, mo i no nidim plante strong man tu blong oli pulumaot.

title: Ezekiel 17:10
content: 10 I tru, igel ya i planem finis. ?Be yufala i ting se bambae i gru? Bambae win i blu strong i kam long is, nao grep ya bambae i ded. Bambae i drae long ples ya we i stap gru long hem.’ ”

title: Ezekiel 17:11
content: 11 Nao Hae God i talem long mi se,

title: Ezekiel 17:12
content: 12 “Ol man ya oli stap agens long mi. Yu askem long olgeta se, ‘?Yufala i save mining blong parabol ya?’ Yu mas talemaot long olgeta se, ‘King blong Babilonia i go long Jerusalem,* mo i karemaot king blong yufala wetem ol haeman blong taon ya, oli kam wetem hem long Babilonia.

title: Ezekiel 17:13
content: 13 Nao hem i tekem wan man we i famle blong king, nao tufala i mekem promes se tufala kantri blong tufala i save stap gud, tufala i no faet, mo hem i mekem man ya i mekem wan strong promes blong holem promes ya blong hem. Mo hem i holem ol lida blong kantri blong yufala, nao hem i karem olgeta i kam long ples ya, blong oli stap wok slef* long ples ya,

title: Ezekiel 17:14
content: 14 blong ol man ples blong yufala oli mas holem promes ya, oli no save girap bakegen blong mekem wan samting.

title: Ezekiel 17:15
content: 15 Be naoia, man ya i girap, i brekem promes ya, mo i sanem sam man blong wok blong hem oli go long Ijip, blong oli tekem ol hos wetem bigfala kampani blong ol soldia, blong oli kam faet agens long king blong Babilonia. ?Be olsem wanem? ?Bambae hem i save win? Sipos hem i mekem olsem, bambae hem i no save ronwe long panis. Man we i brekem promes blong hem, hem i mas kasem panis from.

title: Ezekiel 17:16
content: 16 “ ‘Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta* blong yufala, mo mi laef, mi stap we mi stap. Mo naoia, mi mi talem stret long yufala, se long nem blong mi, man ya i mas ded long Babilonia. Hem i no moa holem tok blong hem, mo i no wantem stap fren gud wetem king blong Babilonia. Hem i brekem promes ya we i mekem wetem king ya, mo bambae hem i mas ded from.

title: Ezekiel 17:17
content: 17 Mo sipos ol man Babilonia oli go digim hol i goraon long Jerusalem, mo oli hivimap graon blong oli haed biaen long hem blong kilim ol man oli ded, nating we ol soldia ya blong Ijip we oli strong tumas oli kam blong givhan long man ya we i stap rul, be bambae oli no save givhan long hem blong faet agens long olgeta ya.

title: Ezekiel 17:18
content: 18 Hem i brekem promes ya we hem i mekem, mo hem i no holem tok blong hem we i mekem wetem king blong Babilonia blong i stap fren gud wetem hem, mo from samting ya, bambae hem i no save ronwe long panis.

title: Ezekiel 17:19
content: 19 “Naoia mi mi talem stret long yufala, se long nem blong mi, mi bambae mi panisim hem. Hem i brekem promes ya we i mekem long nem blong mi, blong i stap fren gud wetem king blong Babilonia, mo from samting ya, hem i mas lus.

title: Ezekiel 17:20
content: 20 Bambae mi putum trap blong mi blong kasem hem, nao bambae mi tekem hem i go long Babilonia. Long ples ya, bambae mi panisim hem, from we tingting blong hem i no moa stap strong long mi, i tanem baksaed long mi.

title: Ezekiel 17:21
content: 21 Mo bambae ol enemi oli kilim ol nambawan soldia blong hem long faet, mo olgeta we oli stap laef, bambae ol enemi ya oli ronem olgeta oli go olbaot long evri ples. Nao bambae yufala i savegud we mi mi Hae God, mo hemia tok blong mi.’ ”

title: Ezekiel 17:22-23
content: 22-23 Hae God i Masta* blong yumi, mo hem i talem se, “Mi bambae mi holem top blong wan sida* we i longfala, mi brekemaot top blong hem we i sofsof, nao bambae mi tekem i go long Isrel,* mi go planem antap long wan hil we i hae we i hae. Bambae hem i gat ol han blong hem, mo i karem frut, mo bambae i kam wan nambawan sida. Mo bambae ol naranarafala pijin oli kam stap long ples ya, oli haed long hem.

title: Ezekiel 17:24
content: 24 Nao bambae olgeta tri long kantri ya oli savegud we mi mi Hae God. Mi nao mi stap katemdaon ol longlongfala tri, mo mi stap mekem ol sotsotfala tri oli gru, oli kam longlongfala. Mo mi stap mekem ol tri we oli stap gru, oli kam drae, mo mi stap mekem olgeta we oli drae finis, oli gru bakegen. Mi bambae mi mekem samting ya. Mi mi Hae God, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 18:1
content: 1 Nao Hae God i talem long mi se,

title: Ezekiel 18:2
content: 2 “?Wanem tok ya we oltaem ol laen* blong Isrel* oli stap taltalem olbaot long kantri ya blong yufala? Oli stap talem se, ‘Ol papa oli kakae frut blong grep* we i konkon, be ol pikinini blong olgeta oli kasem konkon ya blong hem.’

title: Ezekiel 18:3
content: 3 “Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta* blong yufala, mo mi laef, mi stap we mi stap. Mo naoia, mi mi talem stret long yufala, se long nem blong mi, bambae yufala i no moa save taltalem tok ya bakegen.

title: Ezekiel 18:4
content: 4 Laef blong olgeta man i blong mi. Laef blong papa mo mama, mo laef blong pikinini tu, i blong mi. Be sipos man i mekem sin, hem bambae i ded from.

title: Ezekiel 18:5
content: 5 “Yufala i traem tingbaot gudfala man. Man olsem, fasin blong hem i stret gud, mo oltaem, hem i stap holemgud ol loa.

title: Ezekiel 18:6
content: 6 Hem i no save mekem wosip long ol aedol ya we ol narafala laen blong Isrel oli stap mekem wosip long olgeta antap long ol hil, mo i no save kakae mit we oli mekem sakrefaes long hem long ol aedol ya. Hem i no save trikim woman blong narafala man blong i slip wetem hem, mo i no save slip wetem woman we i gat sik blong woman.

title: Ezekiel 18:7
content: 7 Hem i no save mekem i strong long ol narafala man. Hem i no save stil, mo oltaem, sipos wan man i tekem wan samting long hem blong yusum fastaem, nao man ya i givim wan narafala samting long hem olsem garanti we bambae hem i givimbak samting ya long hem, biaen, taem man ya i givimbak samting ya long hem, hem i save givimbak garanti ya long man blong hem. Hem i save givim kakae long man we i no gat kakae, mo i save givim klos long man we i no gat klos.

title: Ezekiel 18:8
content: 8 Hem i no save givim mane long narafala man blong i winim intres long hem. Oltaem hem i no wantem mekem rabis fasin. Taem ol man oli rao from wan samting, hem i save givim gudfala tok blong stretem rao blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 18:9
content: 9 Man olsem, oltaem hem i stap obei long ol tok blong mi, mo i stap holemgud ol loa blong mi. Hem i wan stret man, mo bambae hem i save stap gud. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala, mo hemia tok blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 18:10-11
content: 10-11 “Be maet man ya i gat wan pikinini we i no save folem ol fasin blong hem nating. Pikinini ya i stap stil, mo i stap kilim man i ded. Hem i stap kakae mit we oli mekem sakrefaes long hem long ol ples blong mekem wosip antap long ol hil, mo i stap trikim ol woman blong ol narafala man blong i slip wetem olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 18:12
content: 12 Hem i stap mekem i strong long ol puaman mo olgeta we oli no gat paoa. Hem i stap stil, mo oltaem, sipos wan man i tekem wan samting long hem blong yusum fastaem, nao man ya i givim wan narafala samting long hem olsem garanti we bambae hem i givimbak samting ya long hem, biaen, taem man ya i givimbak samting ya long hem, be hem i no save givimbak garanti blong man ya. Hem i stap go long ol hiten ples blong mekem wosip antap long ol hil, mo i stap mekem wosip long ol aedol ya we oli nogud we i nogud.

title: Ezekiel 18:13
content: 13 Hem i stap givim mane long narafala man blong bambae i winim intres long hem. ?Olsem wanem? ?Bambae man olsem i save stap? !Nogat! !Bambae hem i mas ded! Hem i stap mekem ol samting ya we i nogud we i nogud, mo bambae hem i mas ded from. Bambae hem i ded, be i fol blong hem nomo.

title: Ezekiel 18:14
content: 14 “Be maet man nogud ya i gat wan pikinini blong hem, mo pikinini ya i luk ol sin ya we papa blong hem i stap mekem, be i no save folem ol fasin ya.

title: Ezekiel 18:15
content: 15 Hem i no save mekem wosip long ol aedol ya we ol narafala laen blong Isrel oli stap mekem wosip long olgeta antap long ol hil, mo i no save kakae mit we oli mekem sakrefaes long hem long ol aedol ya. Hem i no save trikim woman blong narafala man blong i slip wetem hem.

title: Ezekiel 18:16
content: 16 Hem i no save mekem i strong long ol narafala man. Hem i no save stil, mo oltaem, sipos wan man i tekem wan samting long hem blong yusum fastaem, hem i no save askem long man ya blong i givim wan narafala samting long hem olsem garanti we bambae hem i givimbak samting ya long hem. Hem i save givim kakae blong hem long man we i no gat kakae, mo i save givim klos long man we i no gat klos.

title: Ezekiel 18:17
content: 17 Hem i no wantem mekem ol rabis fasin. Hem i no save givim mane long narafala man blong i winim intres long hem. Man ya i stap holemgud ol loa blong mi, mo i stap obei long ol tok blong mi. Hem bambae i save stap gud, i no save ded from ol sin ya blong papa blong hem.

title: Ezekiel 18:18
content: 18 Be papa blong hem, from we hem i stap mekem i strong long ol man, mo i stap stil, mo i stap mekem ol samting nogud long ol man ples blong hem, hem bambae i ded.

title: Ezekiel 18:19
content: 19 “Be yufala i stap talem se, ‘?From wanem pikinini blong man ya i no kasem panis from ol sin blong papa blong hem?’ Hem i no save kasem panis, from we hem i stap mekem ol samting we i stret mo i gud. Oltaem hem i stap holemgud ol loa blong mi, mo i stap folemgud olgeta, nao from samting ya, hem bambae i save stap gud.

title: Ezekiel 18:20
content: 20 Man we i mekem sin, hem nomo bambae i ded from. Pikinini i no save kasem panis from ol sin blong papa blong hem, mo papa i no save kasem panis from ol sin blong pikinini blong hem. Man we i stret man bambae i kasem pei blong hem, be man nogud bambae i kasem panis from ol samting nogud we hem i mekem.

title: Ezekiel 18:21
content: 21 “Be sipos wan man nogud i tanem tingting blong hem, nao i no moa mekem sin, mo i holem ol loa blong mi, mo i mekem ol samting we i stret mo i gud, bambae hem i no save ded, i save stap gud.

title: Ezekiel 18:22
content: 22 Bambae mi fogivim hem, mi tekemaot ol sin blong hem, mo mi no moa save tingbaot olgeta bakegen. Bambae hem i save stap gud, from we hem i stap mekem ol samting we i stret.

title: Ezekiel 18:23
content: 23 Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala. ?Yufala i ting se mi mi glad blong luk man nogud i ded? !Nogat! Mi mi glad blong luk we hem i tanem tingting blong hem from ol sin blong hem, nao bambae i stap gud.

title: Ezekiel 18:24
content: 24 “?Be sipos stret man i tanem baksaed long ol gudfala fasin we hem i stap mekem, nao i stat mekem sin, mo ol samting we i nogud olgeta, olsem we ol man nogud oli stap mekem, yufala i ting se bambae hem i save laef? !Nogat! Ol gudgudfala samting we hem i mekem, bambae mi no save tingbaot. Hem i tanem baksaed long mi, i gohed i mekem sin, mo from samting ya, hem bambae i mas ded.

title: Ezekiel 18:25
content: 25 “Be yufala i talem se, ‘Hae God i Masta blong yumi, be ol fasin blong hem i no stret.’ Yufala ol laen blong Isrel, yufala i lesin long mi. ?Yufala i ting se fasin blong mi i no stret? !Yufala nao, fasin blong yufala i no stret!

title: Ezekiel 18:26
content: 26 Taem wan stret man i tanem baksaed long ol stret fasin we hem i stap mekem, nao i stat mekem ol rabis fasin, bambae hem i mas ded from.

title: Ezekiel 18:27
content: 27 Mo bakegen, taem wan man nogud i tanem tingting blong hem, nao i no moa mekem sin, i mekem ol samting we i stret mo i gud, hem bambae i sevem laef blong hem.

title: Ezekiel 18:28
content: 28 Hem i luksave ol sin blong hem, mo i tanem baksaed long olgeta, nao from samting ya, bambae hem i no save ded, hem i save stap gud.

title: Ezekiel 18:29
content: 29 Be yufala i stap talem se, ‘Hae God i Masta blong yumi, be ol fasin blong hem i no stret.’ ?Yufala i ting se fasin blong mi i no stret? !Yufala nao, fasin blong yufala i no stret!

title: Ezekiel 18:30
content: 30 “Nao from samting ya, mi mi talem long yufala, se bambae mi jajem yufala wanwan, stret long ol samting we yufala i mekem. Yufala i mas tanem baksaed long olgeta sin blong yufala. Yufala i no letem ol sin ya oli spolem yufala.

title: Ezekiel 18:31
content: 31 Yufala i mas lego ol rabis fasin ya we yufala i stap mekem agens long mi, mo yufala i mas gat niufala tingting wetem niufala laef. ?From wanem yufala i wantem ded?

title: Ezekiel 18:32
content: 32 Mi mi no glad nating blong man i ded. Yufala i mas tanem baksaed long ol sin blong yufala, nao bambae yufala i save stap gud. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 19:1
content: 1 Nao Hae God i talem long mi blong mi sing long wan singsing blong krae, we i tokbaot tu pikinini blong king blong Juda Sing ya i olsem.

title: Ezekiel 19:2
content: 2 Ol laen* blong Isrel.* Mama blong yufala i olsem wan nambawan woman laeon we i stap lukaot gud long ol pikinini blong hem long medel blong ol man laeon we oli wael.

title: Ezekiel 19:3
content: 3 Hem i lukaot gud long wan pikinini blong hem, gogo i kam wan strong laeon, mo i tijim hem long fasin blong kasem kakae blong hem, nao hem i kam wan laeon blong kakae man.

title: Ezekiel 19:4
content: 4 Nao ol man blong ol narafala kantri oli harem nius blong hem, nao oli digim hol long graon blong hem i foldaon long hem. Nao hem i foldaon long hem, mo oli hukum hem long huk, oli pulum hem i go long Ijip.

title: Ezekiel 19:5
content: 5 Nao mama blong hem i stap wet long hem, be i luk we hem i go lus, i no moa save kambak. Nao hem i girap, i lukaot gud long narafala pikinini blong hem, gogo i kam wan strong laeon.

title: Ezekiel 19:6
content: 6 Taem hem i kam bigwan, hem i go wokbaot wetem ol narafala laeon. Nao hem tu i lanem fasin blong kasem kakae blong hem, mo i kam laeon blong kakae man.

title: Ezekiel 19:7
content: 7 Hem i spolemgud ol strong ples blong haed blong olgeta, mo i flatemgud ol taon blong olgeta tu. Oltaem, taem hem i singaot bigwan, olgeta man blong kantri ya oli fraet we i fraet.

title: Ezekiel 19:8
content: 8 Nao ol man blong ol narafala kantri oli kam wanples, oli raonem hem blong faet agens long hem. Oli hangem net blong olgeta blong blokem hem, nao hem i go pas long net ya we oli hangemrere i stap.

title: Ezekiel 19:9
content: 9 Nao oli holem hem, oli putum hem long wan bigfala bokis we oli stap putum wael anamol long hem, nao oli karem hem i go long king blong Babilonia. Nao oli holem hem i stap long ples ya, mo ol gad oli stap gad long hem, blong bambae ol man oli no moa save harem voes blong hem antap long ol hil blong Juda.

title: Ezekiel 19:10
content: 10 Mama blong yufala i olsem rop ya grep* we oli planem long saed blong reva. Nao from we i gat plante wota long ples ya, i mekem rop ya i gru gud, i gat plante lif mo i karem plante frut.

title: Ezekiel 19:11
content: 11 Nao ol han blong hem oli strong, mo oli kam olsem ol spesel wokingstik blong ol king. Rop ya i gru, i go antap kasem ol klaod, mo olgeta man oli luk we i longfala i go antap, mo i fulap long ol lif.

title: Ezekiel 19:12
content: 12 Be ol man we oli kros tumas long hem, oli girap oli pulumaot stamba blong hem, oli sakem long graon i stap. Nao iswin* i blu long ol frut blong hem, i mekem olgeta oli drae. Mo ol han blong hem oli brobrok, oli kam drae, nao faea i bonem olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 19:13
content: 13 Be naoia oli planem bakegen long drae ples, long ples we i drae tumas, i no gat wota nating long hem.

title: Ezekiel 19:14
content: 14 Nao faea i kasem hem, i bonem ol han mo ol frut blong hem. Bambae ol han ya blong hem oli no moa save strong bakegen, mo oli no moa save kam olsem ol spesel wokingstik blong ol king. Hemia wan sing blong krae we oli stap singsing long hem oltaem nomo.

title: Ezekiel 20:1-3
content: 1-3 Long namba seven yia we yumi stap wok slef* long ples ya, long namba faef manis,* long namba ten dei blong hem, sam lida blong ol laen* blong Isrel* oli kam sidaon long fes blong mi blong faenemaot tingting blong Hae God we i Masta* blong yumi. Nao Hae God i talem long mi se, “Man blong wol ya. Yu talem long ol man ya se, ‘Tok blong mi i olsem. ?Yufala i kam blong faenemaot tingting blong mi? Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala, mo mi laef, mi stap we mi stap. Mo mi mi talem stret long yufala, se long nem blong mi, bambae mi no save letem yufala i askem wan samting nating long mi. Hemia nao tok blong mi.’

title: Ezekiel 20:4
content: 4 “?Olsem wanem? ?Yu yu rere blong talemaot panis blong olgeta ya? Sipos i olsem, yu gohed yu mekem. Yu tok long olgeta blong mekem olgeta oli tingbaot ol samting we ol bubu blong olgeta bifo oli mekem we oli nogud we i nogud.

title: Ezekiel 20:5
content: 5 Yu talem long olgeta we mi mi talem se, ‘Ol laen blong Isrel. Taem mi jusumaot ol olfala blong yufala bifo, mi mekem wan strong promes* long olgeta. Taem oli stap long Ijip, mi soemaot paoa blong mi long olgeta, mo mi talem long olgeta we mi mi Hae God, mi God blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 20:6
content: 6 Long taem ya, mi mi promes blong tekemaot olgeta i gowe long ples ya, blong lidim olgeta oli kam long wan kantri we mi jusumaot finis blong oli kam stap long hem. Kantri ya i gud we i gud, i winim ol narafala kantri long wol. Graon blong hem i gud tumas, oltaem i stap karem fulap kakae.

title: Ezekiel 20:7
content: 7 Mi mi Hae God, be ol aedol ya blong ol man Ijip oli giaman god, mo oli nogud we i nogud long fes blong mi. Be ol bubu ya blong yufala oli laekem olgeta tumas, mo oltaem oli stap mekem wosip long olgeta. Mi talem long olgeta blong oli sakemaot ol aedol ya, blong oli no moa mekem olgeta oli doti long fes blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 20:8
content: 8 Be oli agens long mi, oli no wantem lesin long mi. Oli no sakemaot ol aedol ya. Mo long kantri ya, mi mi rere blong letem olgeta oli haremsave fulpaoa blong kros blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 20:9
content: 9 Be mi mi no mekem olsem, from we sipos mi mekem olsem, ol narafala man we ol bubu blong yufala oli stap long medel blong olgeta, taem oli harem, bambae oli no save ona long nem blong mi. Be long fes blong olgeta, mi mi talemaot long ol bubu ya blong yufala, se bambae mi tekemaot olgeta oli gowe long Ijip.

title: Ezekiel 20:10
content: 10 “Ale, mi tekemaot olgeta long Ijip, mi lidim olgeta i go long draeples.

title: Ezekiel 20:11
content: 11 Nao mi givim tok blong mi long olgeta, mo mi tijim olgeta long ol loa blong mi, mo sipos man i obei long olgeta, hem i save stap gud.

title: Ezekiel 20:12
content: 12 Nao mi givim ol dei blong spel long ol man ya, blong oli holem blong soemaot we mi mi mekem promes wetem olgeta, mo blong mekem olgeta oli save we mi Hae God, mi mekem olgeta oli tabu.

title: Ezekiel 20:13
content: 13 Be long draeples ya tu, oli girap, oli stap agens long mi. Oli brekem ol loa ya blong mi, mo oli tanem baksaed long ol tok ya blong mi. Mo ol dei ya we mi mi makemaot blong oli spel long hem, oli spolemgud olgeta, oli mekem oli no moa tabu. Nao long draeples ya, mi mi rere blong letem olgeta oli haremsave fulpaoa blong kros blong mi, blong mi spolemgud olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 20:14
content: 14 Be mi mi no mekem olsem, from we sipos mi mekem olsem, ol narafala man we oli stap luk we mi tekemaot olgeta ya long Ijip i kam, taem oli harem, bambae oli no save ona long nem blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 20:15
content: 15 Nao mi mekem wan promes long olgeta long draeples, se bambae mi no save tekem olgeta i kam long kantri ya we mi mi givim long olgeta. Kantri ya i gud we i gud, i winim ol narafala kantri long wol. Graon blong hem i gud tumas, oltaem i stap karem fulap kakae.

title: Ezekiel 20:16
content: 16 Be mi mi mekem promes ya from we oli tanem baksaed long ol tok blong mi, mo oli brekem ol loa blong mi, mo oli mekem ol dei ya oli no moa tabu. Oli wantem blong mekem wosip long ol aedol blong olgeta nomo.

title: Ezekiel 20:17
content: 17 “Be mi sore tumas long olgeta, nao mi no kilim olgeta evriwan i ded long draeples.

title: Ezekiel 20:18
content: 18 Nao mi talem long ol yangfala blong olgeta se, ‘Mi mi Hae God we mi God blong yufala. Yufala i no mas holem ol rul ya we ol olfala blong yufala bifo oli folem. Yufala i no mas folem ol kastom blong olgeta, mo yufala i no mas mekem wosip long ol aedol ya blong olgeta, from we sipos yufala i mekem olsem bambae yufala i kam doti long fes blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 20:19
content: 19 Yufala i mas obei long ol loa ya blong mi, mo yufala i mas ona long ol tok ya blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 20:20
content: 20 Yufala i mas mekem ol dei ya oli tabu, blong soemaot we mi mi mekem promes wetem yufala, mo blong yufala i save we mi mi Hae God, mi God blong yufala.’

title: Ezekiel 20:21
content: 21 “Be ol yangfala ya tu oli girap oli stap agens long mi. Oli brekem ol loa ya blong mi, mo oli no holemgud ol tok ya blong mi. Mo ol dei ya, oli mekem olgeta oli no moa tabu. Nao long draeples ya, mi mi rere blong letem olgeta oli haremsave fulpaoa blong kros blong mi, blong mi kilim olgeta evriwan i ded.

title: Ezekiel 20:22
content: 22 Be mi mi no mekem olsem, from we sipos mi mekem olsem, ol narafala man we oli stap luk we mi tekemaot ol bubu ya blong yufala long Ijip i kam, taem oli harem, bambae oli no save ona long nem blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 20:23
content: 23 Nao mi mekem wan promes bakegen long olgeta long draeples, se bambae mi ronemaot olgeta oli go stap olbaot long evri ples long wol.

title: Ezekiel 20:24
content: 24 Promes ya, mi mi mekem from we oli no holem ol tok ya blong mi, mo oli tanem baksaed long ol loa ya blong mi, mo oli mekem ol dei ya oli no moa tabu. Oli wantem nomo blong mekem wosip long ol aedol blong ol olfala blong olgeta bifo.

title: Ezekiel 20:25
content: 25 Nao mi givim ol narafala loa long olgeta we oli nogud, mo mi givim ol narafala tok long olgeta we i no save givhan long olgeta blong oli stap gud.

title: Ezekiel 20:26
content: 26 Mo mi letem olgeta oli mekem ol sakrefaes we i mekem olgeta oli kam doti long fes blong mi. Mi mi letem olgeta oli kilim ol fasbon pikinini boe blong olgeta, blong oli mekem sakrefaes long olgeta i go long ol aedol ya. Hemia i blong panisim olgeta, mo blong soemaot long olgeta we mi mi Hae God.

title: Ezekiel 20:27-28
content: 27-28 “Naoia yu mas talem long ol laen blong Isrel we mi mi talem se, ‘Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala, mo taem mi tekem ol olfala blong yufala bifo oli kam stap long kantri ya we mi bin promes blong givim long olgeta, oli spolem mi bakegen, oli tanem baksaed long mi, oli lego mi. Taem oli luk ol hil we oli hae, mo ol bigbigfala tri we oli no save lusum lif blong olgeta, oli girap, oli go mekem sakrefaes long ol ples ya. Ol ples ya oli ples blong mekem wosip long aedol, mo oli mekem mi mi kros from ol sakrefaes ya blong olgeta we oli bonem blong mekem wosip long ol aedol ya, mo waen ya we oli givim i go long olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 20:29
content: 29 Nao mi askem long olgeta se, ‘?Wanem ol hae ples ya we yufala i stap go long hem?’ Nao i stat long taem ya i kam kasem tede, oli stap talem nem blong ol ples ya se, ‘Ol Hae Ples’.

title: Ezekiel 20:30
content: 30 Naoia mi wantem blong yu talemaot long olgeta ol samting we mi bambae mi talem. Mi talem se, ‘?From wanem yufala i mekem sem sin ya we ol olfala blong yufala bifo oli bin mekem? ?From wanem yufala i stap go biaen long ol aedol ya blong olgeta?

title: Ezekiel 20:31
content: 31 Taem yufala i stap givim ol presen long olgeta, mo yufala i stap kilim ol pikinini boe blong yufala blong mekem sakrefaes long olgeta, yufala i stap mekem yufala i doti long fes blong mi, kam kasem tede. Yufala i stap mekem ol samting ya, be yufala i stap kam long mi yet blong faenemaot tingting blong mi. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala, mo mi laef, mi stap we mi stap. Mo naoia mi talem stret long yufala, se long nem blong mi, bambae mi no save letem yufala i askem wan samting nating long mi.

title: Ezekiel 20:32
content: 32 Yufala i mekem tingting blong yufala i strong finis blong yufala i kam olsem ol man blong ol narafala kantri. Yufala i wantem mekem wosip long ol tri mo ol ston olsem we olgeta ya oli stap mekem, be samting ya bambae i no save kamtru.”

title: Ezekiel 20:33
content: 33 Nao Hae God i talem se, “Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta* blong yufala, mo mi laef, mi stap we mi stap. Mi mi kros we mi kros long yufala, mo mi talem stret long yufala, se long nem blong mi, bambae mi rulum yufala, mi meksave yufala long fulpaoa blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 20:34
content: 34 Sipos mi tekemaot yufala long olgeta kantri ya we mi mi ronem yufala i go stap long olgeta, mo mi tekem yufala i kam wanples, bambae mi soemaot long yufala we mi mi gat paoa mo we mi kros tumas long yufala.

title: Ezekiel 20:35
content: 35 Bambae mi tekem yufala i kam stap long Draeples ya we i blong Olgeta Man, mo long ples ya nao, bambae mi jajem yufala stret long fes blong yufala.

title: Ezekiel 20:36
content: 36 Mo bambae mi jajem yufala, olsem we mi jajem ol olfala blong yufala bifo long draeples ya Sinae. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala, mo hemia tok blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 20:37
content: 37 “Nao biaen long ol samting ya, bambae mi holemtaet yufala, blong mekem yufala i obei long promes* ya we mi mekem wetem yufala.

title: Ezekiel 20:38
content: 38 Bambae mi tekemaot ol man ya we oli stap long medel blong yufala we oli man blong girap agens long mi, mo oli man blong mekem sin. Bambae mi tekemaot olgeta long ol kantri ya we oli stap long hem naoia, be bambae mi no letem olgeta oli gobak long kantri ya Isrel* bakegen. Nao bambae yufala i savegud we mi mi Hae God.

title: Ezekiel 20:39
content: 39 “Mi mi talem long yufala, se sipos yufala i no wantem lesin long mi, i gud yufala i gohed, yufala i mekem wosip long ol aedol ya blong yufala. Be mi mi talem stret long yufala, se biaen long ol samting ya, bambae mi mekem yufala i obei long mi. Bambae yufala i mas livim fasin ya we yufala i stap givim presen i go long ol aedol ya blong yufala, from we fasin ya i stap spolem tabu nem blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 20:40-41
content: 40-41 Fastaem mi mi ronem yufala i go stap long ol narafala kantri. Be bambae mi tekemaot yufala long ol kantri ya, mi tekem yufala i kambak, yufala i stap wanples bakegen. Nao long kantri ya blong yufala, bambae yufala ol laen* blong Isrel evriwan i save mekem wosip long mi long tabu hil* ya blong mi we i hae we i hae. Mo bambae mi glad long yufala, mo mi luk long yufala, blong yufala i mekem ol sakrefaes long mi, mo blong yufala i karem ol gudgudfala samting i kam long mi, wetem ol presen ya we oli tabu we yufala i stap givim i kam long mi. Nao bambae mi glad long yufala, olsem we mi glad long gudfala insens* we yufala i stap bonem i kam long mi. Mo bambae olgeta man long olgeta ples oli save luk we mi mi tabu.

title: Ezekiel 20:42
content: 42 Taem mi tekem yufala i kambak long kantri ya we mi bin promes blong givim long ol olfala blong yufala bifo, bambae yufala i savegud we mi mi Hae God.

title: Ezekiel 20:43
content: 43 Nao long taem ya, bambae yufala i tingbaot olgeta samting ya we yufala i bin mekem we oli blong sem nomo, mo ol fasin ya we yufala i mekem, we i mekem yufala i doti long fes blong mi. Mo bambae yufala i ting rabis long yufala bakegen from ol samting nogud ya we yufala i bin mekem.

title: Ezekiel 20:44
content: 44 Yufala i stap mekem ol rabis fasin, mo ol samting we oli nogud tumas, mo i stret blong mi spolem yufala from ol fasin ya. Be bambae mi no save mekem olsem. Bambae mi mekem i gud long yufala blong leftemap hae nem blong mi. Nao long taem ya, bambae yufala i savegud we mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 20:45
content: 45 Hae God i Masta* blong yumi, mo hem i talem long mi se,

title: Ezekiel 20:46
content: 46 “Man blong wol ya. Yu lukluk i go long saot. Yu tok agens long bigfala bus ya long saot, yu talemaot tok blong mi,

title: Ezekiel 20:47
content: 47 blong hem i harem. Mi mi talem se, ‘!Yu luk! Mi mi rere blong putum faea long yu, mo faea ya bambae i bonem yu we bambae i flatemgud ol tri blong yu. Ol tri we i laef wetem ol tri we oli drae finis, faea ya bambae i flatemgud olgeta evriwan, mo i no gat man we bambae i save kilim faea ya. Bambae i bonem bigfala bus ya, i stat long narasaed long saot i kam kasem narasaed long not, mo olgeta man bambae oli harem nogud long hot blong faea ya.

title: Ezekiel 20:48
content: 48 Mo olgeta man evriwan bambae oli luksave we mi mi laetem faea ya, mo i no gat man bambae i save kilim.”

title: Ezekiel 20:49
content: 49 Nao mi talem se, “Hae God. Yu yu Masta blong mi. Mi mi harem se mi no save talemaot tok ya. Oltaem ol man oli stap tokbaot mi se, ‘!Man ya i man blong talem parabol nomo!’ ”

title: Ezekiel 21:1
content: 1 Nao Hae God i toktok long mi bakegen long wan vison,

title: Ezekiel 21:2
content: 2 i talem se, “Man blong wol ya. Yu tok agens long taon ya Jerusalem.* Mo yu tok agens long ol ples ya we ol man oli stap go long olgeta blong mekem wosip. Yu tok blong wekemap ol laen* blong Isrel,* yu talemaot long olgeta

title: Ezekiel 21:3
content: 3 we mi mi talem se, ‘Mi mi enemi blong yufala. Bambae mi pulumaot naef blong faet blong mi long paos blong hem, nao mi kilim yufala evriwan i ded, ol man nogud wetem ol stret man tu.

title: Ezekiel 21:4
content: 4 Bambae mi kilim yufala evriwan, i stat long saot i go kasem long not.

title: Ezekiel 21:5
content: 5 Mo bambae olgeta man oli savegud we mi Hae God, mi pulumaot naef blong faet blong mi finis, mo bambae mi no moa save putum i gobak long paos blong hem bakegen.

title: Ezekiel 21:6
content: 6 “Nao from samting ya, i gud yu harem nogud, yu krae, blong soemaot we tingting blong yu i foldaon olgeta. Yu sore, yu go krae long ples we olgeta man oli save lukluk yu.

title: Ezekiel 21:7
content: 7 Mo sipos oli askem long yu se, ‘?From wanem yu stap harem nogud, yu stap krae?’, bambae yu talem long olgeta se, ‘Mi stap harem nogud from wan badnius we bambae i kamtru. Taem badnius ya i kamtru, bambae yufala i fraet we i fraet, mo ol han blong yufala bambae oli slak, oli stap hang nomo olsem we oli ded. Bambae tingting blong yufala i foldaon olgeta, mo bambae yufala i seksek gud. Samting ya i stap kam, mo bambae i mas kamtru.’ Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta* blong yufala, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 21:8
content: 8 Mo hem i talem long mi bakegen se,

title: Ezekiel 21:9
content: 9 “Yu mas talemaot tok we bambae mi givim long yu. Yu mas talem se, ‘Wan naef blong faet i sap we i sap, mo i saen we i saen.

title: Ezekiel 21:10
content: 10 Ol man oli sapenemrere blong kilim man i ded, mo oli saenemgud, i saen we i saen olsem laetning. ?Yufala i ting se bambae yufala i save stap gud, yufala i glad? Mi mi stap tok blong wonem yufala, mo mi stap panisim yufala, be yufala i no wantem harem tok blong mi nating.

title: Ezekiel 21:11
content: 11 Naef ya, ol man oli stap saenemrere blong yusum. Oli sapenemgud finis, nao oli saenemgud blong givim long man blong kilim man blong hem i yusum.

title: Ezekiel 21:12
content: 12 Man blong wol ya. Yu yu mas sore, yu mas krae bigwan. Naef ya i blong kilim olgeta man blong mi. Bambae mi yusum blong kilim ol lida blong yufala. Wetem ol narafala man blong mi. Yu mas soemaot we tingting blong yu i foldaon olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 21:13
content: 13 Mi mi stap traem olgeta man blong mi, mo sipos oli no wantem tanem tingting blong olgeta from ol rabis fasin blong olgeta, bambae samting ya i mas kamtru long olgeta.’

title: Ezekiel 21:14
content: 14 “Naoia yu mas go talemaot tok ya we mi mi givim long yu. Yu mas mekem wan saen, nao naef ya blong kilim man bambae i gohed, i stap katkatem ol man. Bambae hem i mekem ol man blong mi oli fraet we i fraet, mo i kilim olgeta i ded.

title: Ezekiel 21:15
content: 15 Bambae hem i mekem olgeta oli lusum tingting blong olgeta, nao oli stambol, oli folfoldaon. Mi talemaot long taon ya blong olgeta, se bambae mi spolem hem long naef ya we i stap saen olsem laetning, mo i rere blong kilim man i ded.

title: Ezekiel 21:16
content: 16 Yu naef blong faet we yu sap gud, yu sakem yu i go long raetsaed mo long lefsaed, yu kilim ol man i ded long evri ples we yu go long hem.

title: Ezekiel 21:17
content: 17 Nao mi tu bambae mi mekem saen ya, mo bambae kros blong mi i finis. Mi mi Hae God, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 21:18
content: 18 Nao Hae God i toktok long mi bakegen long vison ya,

title: Ezekiel 21:19
content: 19 i talem se, “Man blong wol ya. Yu mas droem pija blong wan rod we i gat fok long hem, we king blong Babilonia bambae i karem naef blong faet blong hem, i pas long hem. Yu mas soemaot we stamba blong rod ya i stat long wan kantri nomo. Mo long ples we rod ya i karem fok long hem, yu mas droem pija blong wan saenpos we i gat tu ara long hem.

title: Ezekiel 21:20
content: 20 Wan ara bambae i poen long rod we king i save pas long hem blong go long kantri ya Amon, blong go long taon ya Raba. Mo narawan bambae i poen long rod we hem i save pas long hem, blong go long kantri ya Juda,* blong go long taon ya Jerusalem* we bigfala stonwol i goraon long hem.

title: Ezekiel 21:21
content: 21 Naoia king ya i stap stanap long saenpos ya, long ples we rod ya i gat fok long hem. Nao long ples ya, hem i stap holem ol ara blong bonara blong hem, i stap seksekem olgeta, mo i toktok long ol aedol blong hem blong faenemaot tingting blong olgeta, mo i luklukgud long leva blong anamol ya we hem i mekem sakrefaes long hem. Hem i stap mekem ol samting ya blong faenemaot rod we bambae hem i save pas long hem.

title: Ezekiel 21:22
content: 22 Nao hem i pulumaot ara blong hem we i makem Jerusalem, i stap holem long raet han blong hem. Ara ya i talem long hem, se i mas go mekemrere ol bigbigfala wud blong kilimdaon bigfala stonwol blong taon ya, mo i mas singaot long ol man blong hem, se i taem blong faet. Mo ara ya i talem long hem tu, se i mas go tekem ol bigbigfala wud blong go sperem ol doa* blong bigfala stonwol blong taon ya, mo i mas digim ol longlongfala hol i goraon long taon ya, mo i mas hivimap graon i goraon long hem.

title: Ezekiel 21:23
content: 23 Bambae ol man Jerusalem oli no save bilif long ol samting ya, from we oli mekem strong promes finis wetem king ya blong oli stap gud wetem hem, oli gat pis. Be tok ya we mi talem naoia i blong mekem olgeta oli tingbaot ol sin blong olgeta, mo i blong talemaot long olgeta we bambae king ya i holem olgeta, i karemaot olgeta oli go wok slef* long ples blong hem.

title: Ezekiel 21:24
content: 24 “Nao from samting ya, mi mi talem stret long yufala se, ‘Ol sin blong yufala i stap long klia ples finis. Olgeta man oli save se yufala i man blong mekem ol samting we oli nogud we i nogud long fes blong mi. Long olgeta samting we yufala i stap mekem, yufala i stap soemaot ol sin blong yufala. Mi talem stret long yufala, se yufala i mas kasem panis. Mi bambae mi putum yufala long han blong ol enemi blong yufala.’

title: Ezekiel 21:25
content: 25 “Yu ya we yu stap rulum ol laen* blong Isrel,* yu yu prapa man nogud we yu nogud olgeta. Yu no folem fasin blong mi nating. Naoia lasdei blong yu i stap kam klosap, we bambae mi panisim yu we mi flatemgud yu.

title: Ezekiel 21:26
content: 26 Yu tekemaot hat ya blong king i gowe long hed blong yu, mo yu tekemaot spesel kaliko ya we yu stap fasem hed blong yu long hem. Olgeta samting long ples blong yu bambae i mas jenis. Yu mas leftemap ol puaman, yu mas givim paoa long olgeta, mo ol man we oli stap rul naoia, yu mas tekemaot hae nem blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 21:27
content: 27 Yes, bambae mi spolem taon ya blong yu we bambae mi spolemgud. Be samting ya i no save kamtru, gogo kasem taem we man ya we mi jusumaot hem blong i panisim taon ya, i kamtru. Nao bambae mi givim taon ya long hem.”

title: Ezekiel 21:28
content: 28 Mo long vison ya, Hae God we i Masta* blong yumi, hem i toktok long mi bakegen, i talem se, “Man blong wol ya. Naoia ol man Amon oli stap tok nogud agens long yufala ol laen* blong Isrel,* be yu mas talemaot ol samting we mi mi stap talem agens long olgeta. Mi mi talem se, ‘Ol man Amon. Naef blong faet i stap rere finis blong spolem yufala. Ol man oli saenemrere finis, i stap saen olsem laetning, mo i rere blong kilim yufala i ded.

title: Ezekiel 21:29
content: 29 Ol vison* we yufala i stap luk oli no tru nating, mo ol samting we yufala i stap talemaot se bambae oli kamtru, be yufala i stap giaman nomo. Yufala i man nogud we i nogud. Yufala i no folem fasin blong mi nating. Naoia lasdei blong yufala i stap kam klosap, we bambae mi panisim yufala we mi flatemgud yufala. Bambae naef ya i katemaot nek blong yufala evriwan.

title: Ezekiel 21:30
content: 30 “Yufala i mas putum ol naef blong faet blong yufala i gobak long paos blong olgeta. Bambae mi jajem yufala stret long ples we yufala i bon long hem.

title: Ezekiel 21:31
content: 31 Bambae yufala i haremsave paoa blong kros blong mi we bambae i strong we i strong. Mo bambae mi letem yufala i go long han blong ol strong man ya, we taem oli faet, oli no gat sore long man nating. Olgeta ya oli savegud fasin blong spolem ol samting.

title: Ezekiel 21:32
content: 32 Bambae faea i spolem yufala evriwan. Bambae blad blong yufala i ron nomo long kantri blong yufala bakegen, mo bambae i no gat man i save tingbaot yufala bakegen samtaem. Mi mi Hae God, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 22:1
content: 1 Hae God i Masta* blong yumi, mo hem i toktok long mi bakegen long wan vison,

title: Ezekiel 22:2
content: 2 i talem se, “Man blong wol ya. ?Yu yu rere blong jajem taon ya Jerusalem* we i fulap long ol man blong kilim man? Ol samting ya we ol man ya oli stap mekem, oli nogud we i nogud long fes blong mi, mo yu yu mas soemaot ol samting ya long olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 22:3
content: 3 Yu mas talem long ol man blong taon ya we mi mi talem se, ‘Yufala i kilim plante man i ded, mo yufala i mekem yufala i doti long fes blong mi, from we yufala i stap mekem wosip long ol aedol we yufala i wokem.

title: Ezekiel 22:4
content: 4 From ol samting ya, yufala i kam nogud olgeta long fes blong mi, mo naoia taem blong yufala i kam klosap, dei blong yufala blong kasem panis i kamtru finis. From samting ya nao, mi letem ol man blong ol narafala kantri oli stap jikim yufala, mo oli stap laf nogud long yufala.

title: Ezekiel 22:5
content: 5 Ol kantri klosap long yufala mo ol kantri longwe, oli stap jikim yufala, from we yufala i stap brekem ol loa blong mi, yufala i no folem nating.

title: Ezekiel 22:6
content: 6 Ol lida blong yufala oli stap yusum paoa blong olgeta blong kilim man i ded.

title: Ezekiel 22:7
content: 7 I no gat man nating long taon ya we i stap ona long papa mo mama blong hem. Yufala i stap giagiaman long ol man blong ol narafala kantri blong stil long olgeta, mo yufala i stap stil long ol widowoman, mo long ol pikinini we papa blong olgeta i ded.

title: Ezekiel 22:8
content: 8 Yufala i no save ona long ol samting we oli tabu, oli blong mi, mo yufala i no save holem ol dei we mi mi makemaot blong yufala i spel long hem.

title: Ezekiel 22:9
content: 9 Sam long yufala oli stap tokbaot ol narafala man, oli stap talem ol giaman toktok, blong bambae oli save kilim olgeta oli ded. Mo sam oli stap kakae mit we oli yusum blong mekem sakrefaes long ol aedol. Mo sam oli wantem woman tumas, nao oli stap mekem sin oltaem.

title: Ezekiel 22:10
content: 10 Mo sam oli stap slip wetem ol mama blong olgeta, mo sam oli stap fosem ol woman we oli gat sik blong woman, blong oli go slip wetem olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 22:11
content: 11 Mo sam oli stap stilim ol woman blong ol narafala man, mo sam oli stap switim ol woman blong ol pikinini blong olgeta, mo ol sista blong olgeta, nao oli stap giagiaman long olgeta blong slip wetem olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 22:12
content: 12 Mo sam long yufala oli stap kilim man i ded blong winim mane. Mo sam oli stap winim intres long ol lon we oli givim long ol narafala laen* blong Isrel,* nao oli kam rijman from we oli stil long olgeta. Olgeta ya oli fogetem mi finis. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala, mo hemia tok blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 22:13
content: 13 “Bambae mi agensem yufala, mi panisim yufala, from we mi kros we mi kros long fasin nogud ya blong yufala, we yufala i stap stil long ol man, mo yufala i stap kilim ol man oli ded.

title: Ezekiel 22:14
content: 14 Bambae mi mi panisim yufala, mo long taem ya, bambae yufala i no gat paoa blong faet agens long mi. Mi mi talem stret long yufala, se mi bambae mi panisim yufala olsem we mi mi talem.

title: Ezekiel 22:15
content: 15 Bambae mi ronemaot yufala i go stap wanwan olbaot wetem ol man long ol narafala kantri. Mo bambae mi waepemaot ol fasin nogud blong yufala evriwan.

title: Ezekiel 22:16
content: 16 Nao bambae ol man long ol narafala kantri oli no save ona long yufala, mo bambae yufala i savegud we mi mi Hae God.”

title: Ezekiel 22:17
content: 17 Mo long vison ya, Hae God we i Masta* blong yumi, hem i toktok long mi bakegen,

title: Ezekiel 22:18-20
content: 18-20 i talem se, “Man blong wol ya. Ol laen* blong Isrel* ya oli nogud nating long fes blong mi. Sipos man i wantem gudfala silva, hem i mas tekem ston we i gat silva mo kopa mo aean mo led mo tin i stap insaed long hem, nao i mas bonem long faea blong mekem ol narafala samting ya oli ronaot, nao gudfala silva nomo i stap. Mo ol man ya oli olsem ol samting ya nomo, mo mi no save yusum olgeta blong mekem wan samting. Mi mi kros tumas long olgeta, mo bambae mi tekem olgeta evriwan i kam wanples long Jerusalem,* nao kros ya blong mi bambae i kasem olgeta we bambae i bonem olgeta, oli ronaot olsem we faea i bonem ston i mekem ol samting ya i ronaot.

title: Ezekiel 22:21
content: 21 Yes, mi mi kros we mi kros tumas long olgeta, mo bambae mi tekem olgeta evriwan i kam wanples long Jerusalem, mi meksave olgeta. Kros ya blong mi bambae i olsem faea we i hot we i hot, nao i bonem olgeta i mekem olgeta oli ronaot.

title: Ezekiel 22:22
content: 22 Bambae mi bonem olgeta long Jerusalem olsem we faea i bonem silva, nao bambae oli haremsave paoa blong kros blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 22:23
content: 23 Mo long vison ya, Hae God we i Masta* blong yumi, hem i toktok long mi bakegen,

title: Ezekiel 22:24
content: 24 i talem se, “Man blong wol ya. Yu talem long ol laen* blong Isrel,* se kantri blong olgeta i no moa klin nating long fes blong mi, i fulap long ol rabis fasin nomo, nao from samting ya, mi mi kros, mo bambae mi panisim olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 22:25
content: 25 Ol pikinini blong king blong olgeta oli olsem ol laeon, we taem oli stap kakae mit blong anamol we oli kilim, oli stap singsingaot. Oli stap kilim ol man, mo oli tekem ol mane blong olgeta wetem ol narafala samting blong olgeta tu. Nao from we oli kilim plante man oli ded, oli mekem plante woman oli stap we oli wido.

title: Ezekiel 22:26
content: 26 Ol pris* blong olgeta oli brekem loa blong mi, mo oli no ona nating long ol samting we oli tabu we oli blong mi. Ol samting we i tabu mo ol samting we i no tabu oli miksimap nomo, oli no seraot olgeta. Oli no tijim ol man blong oli luksave ol samting we oli klin, mo ol samting we oli no klin. Mo oli no holem ol dei ya we mi makemaot olgeta blong oli spel long hem. Nao from samting ya, olgeta oli no ona long mi nating.

title: Ezekiel 22:27
content: 27 Ol haeman blong olgeta oli olsem ol wael dog we oli kilim anamol i ded, nao oli stap brebrekem blong kakae. Oli stap kilim man i ded blong oli kam rijman.

title: Ezekiel 22:28
content: 28 Ol profet blong olgeta oli stap haedem ol sin ya olsem we man i waetwas long wol blong haos blong blokem doti. Oli stap luk ol rabis vison mo oli stap talemaot ol giaman toktok, se ol samting we oli talem bambae oli kamtru. Oli stap talem se oli talemaot tok blong mi, be mi mi no toktok long olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 22:29
content: 29 Ol rijman oli stap giagiaman long ol man, blong oli stil long olgeta. Oli stap mekem i strong tumas long ol puaman mo olgeta we oli no gat paoa, mo oli stap stil long ol man blong ol narafala kantri we oli stap wetem olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 22:30
content: 30 Taem mi mi kros tumas, mo mi rere blong spolemgud kantri ya, mi traem lukaot wan long olgeta we i save wokem stonwol. Mi wantem blong hem i save stanap long ples we stonwol i brobrok long hem, blong blokem kantri ya, blong mi no spolem, be mi no save faenem wan man nating.

title: Ezekiel 22:31
content: 31 Nao from samting ya, mi mi kros tumas long olgeta, nao kros ya blong mi bambae i olsem faea we i bonem olgeta, i spolemgud olgeta from ol samting ya we oli stap mekem. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yufala, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 23:1
content: 1 Nao Hae God i toktok long mi long wan vison bakegen,

title: Ezekiel 23:2
content: 2 i talem se, “Man blong wol ya. Bifo i gat tu sista i stap.

title: Ezekiel 23:3
content: 3 Taem tufala i yang gel yet, tufala i stap long Ijip. Mo long taem ya, ol man oli kam slip wetem tufala, nao tufala i kam woman blong rod.

title: Ezekiel 23:4
content: 4 Fasbon, nem blong hem Ohola, mo narawan, nem blong hem Oholiba Ohola ya, hem i pija blong ol man Sameria,* mo Oholiba, hem i pija blong ol man Jerusalem.* Nao mi mared long tufala, mo tufala i bonem ol pikinini blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 23:5
content: 5 “Nao nating we Ohola i woman blong mi, be hem i girap, i gohed long fasin blong woman blong rod, mo i stap wantem ol man Asiria we i wantem olgeta tumas.

title: Ezekiel 23:6
content: 6 Olgeta ya oli soldia we klos blong olgeta i pepol. Sam long olgeta oli haeman, mo sam oli kapten blong ol soldia, mo olgeta evriwan oli yangfala mo oli naes we i naes, mo oli man blong ron long hos.

title: Ezekiel 23:7
content: 7 Hem i woman blong rod we oltaem ol kapten ya blong ol man Asiria oli stap slip wetem hem. Hem i wantem tumas ol man ya, nao fasin ya i mekem we hem i stap go mekem wosip long ol aedol blong olgeta, mo i mekem hem i kam doti moa long fes blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 23:8
content: 8 Hem i gohed long fasin ya we hem i statem long Ijip, long taem ya we hem i yang gel nomo, we ol man oli stap slip wetem hem, mo ol man oli stap mekem sem fasin long hem yet.

title: Ezekiel 23:9
content: 9 From samting ya, mi putum hem long han blong ol man Asiria ya we hem i wantem olgeta tumas.

title: Ezekiel 23:10
content: 10 Oli tekemaot klos blong hem, mo oli holem ol pikinini boe blong hem mo ol dota blong hem, nao oli kilim hem i ded long naef blong faet. Mo oltaem, olgeta woman long evri ples oli stap tokbaot trabol ya blong hem.

title: Ezekiel 23:11
content: 11 “Nao nating we sista blong hem Oholiba i luk ol samting ya, be hem i go moa long fasin blong woman blong rod, i winim fasin blong Ohola.

title: Ezekiel 23:12
content: 12 Hem tu i wantem tumas ol man ya blong Asiria. Olgeta ya, i gat ol haeman blong gavman, mo ol kapten blong ol soldia, mo ol soldia blong ron long hos. Olgeta evriwan oli yangfala, we oli naes we i naes, mo ol klos blong faet blong olgeta oli flas gud.

title: Ezekiel 23:13
content: 13 Mo mi luk we hem tu i nogud olgeta, i sem mak nomo wetem sista ya blong hem.

title: Ezekiel 23:14-15
content: 14-15 “Be rabis fasin ya blong hem wetem ol man ya i kam mowas olgeta. Hem i luk ol pija blong ol kapten blong ol soldia ya blong Babilonia we oli bon long distrik ya Koldia. Ol pija ya, ol man oli katem olgeta long stonwol, mo oli pentem olgeta oli red gud, mo i gat strap blong olgeta we oli fasem klos blong olgeta long hem, mo i gat ol spesel kaliko we oli fasem hed blong olgeta long hem.

title: Ezekiel 23:16
content: 16 Nao taem hem i luk ol pija blong ol man ya, hem i wantem olgeta tumas, nao i sanem sam man i go long Koldia blong tekem olgeta i kam.

title: Ezekiel 23:17
content: 17 Nao ol man ya oli kam slip wetem hem, mo oli mekem hem i doti long fes blong mi long rabis fasin ya blong olgeta, gogo hem i harem nogud long olgeta, i lukluk rabis long olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 23:18
content: 18 Hem i stap soemaot hem long fes blong olgeta man, mo long fasin ya, oli luk we hem i woman blong rod. Mo hem i mekem mi mi lukluk rabis long hem, olsem we mi mekem long sista blong hem fastaem.

title: Ezekiel 23:19
content: 19 Hem i kam woman blong rod we i bitim mak olgeta. Hem i mekem stret olsem we hem i stap mekem long Ijip bifo, long taem ya we hem i yang gel yet.

title: Ezekiel 23:20
content: 20 Hem i stap wantem tumas ol man ya we oli stap wantem ol woman tumas, mo we fasin blong olgeta i olsem fasin blong dongki mo hos.

title: Ezekiel 23:21
content: 21 “Oholiba. Yu yu wantem blong folem bakegen rabis fasin ya we yu stap mekem long Ijip bifo. Long taem ya yu yu yang gel yet, mo yu stap letem ol man oli stap pleplei wetem titi blong yu, mo yu letem olgeta oli slip wetem yu fastaem we yu no mared yet, nao oli spolem yu.”

title: Ezekiel 23:22-23
content: 22-23 Mo long vison ya, Hae God we i Masta* blong yumi, hem i talem long Oholiba se, “Ol man Babilonia, mo ol man Koldia, mo ol man Pekod, mo ol man Soa, mo ol man Koa, mo ol man Asiria, yu yu wantem olgeta tumas. Olgeta ya oli yang man we oli naes we i naes. Sam long olgeta oli haeman blong gavman, mo sam oli kapten blong ol soldia, mo sam oli komanda, mo sam oli narafala haeman, we olgeta ya evriwan oli stap ron long hos, be yu yu taed finis long olgeta. Mo naoia, mi mi talem stret long yu, se bambae mi mekem olgeta oli kros long yu, mo mi tekem olgeta oli kam hivap raon long yu, blong mekem faet long yu.

title: Ezekiel 23:24
content: 24 Bambae oli aot long not wetem plante soldia blong olgeta, mo ol kat blong faet, mo ol narafala kat blong olgeta, nao bambae oli kam blong mekem faet long yu. Bambae oli putum ol hat blong faet blong olgeta, mo oli karem ol sil* blong blokem olgeta, nao bambae oli hivap raon long yu, oli faet long yu. Mo bambae mi letem yu yu go long han blong olgeta, nao bambae oli jajem yu long loa blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 23:25
content: 25 Mo from we yu mekem mi mi kros tumas, bambae mi letem olgeta oli kros long yu, nao oli faet strong long yu. Bambae oli katemaot nus blong yu mo sora blong yu, mo bambae oli kilim olgeta pikinini blong yu oli ded. Bambae oli holem olgeta, oli bonem olgeta long ol olta blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 23:26
content: 26 Mo bambae oli tekemaot klos blong yu, mo oli tekem ol flas ston blong yu, oli karem i blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 23:27
content: 27 I stat bifo long Ijip, oltaem yu yu wantem ol man tumas, mo yu stap holem fasin nogud ya kam kasem tede, be bambae mi mi mekem yu yu finis long fasin ya blong yu. Bambae yu no moa save putum tingting blong yu i stap long ol aedol ya bakegen, mo bambae yu no moa save tingbaot Ijip bakegen.

title: Ezekiel 23:28
content: 28 “Bambae mi letem yu yu go long han blong ol man ya we yu no wantem olgeta nating, yu stap ting rabis long olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 23:29-30
content: 29-30 Mo from we oli no wantem yu nating, bambae oli kam karemaot ol samting ya we yu yu hadwok from. Bambae oli mekem yu yu stap neked nomo we i no gat wan samting i save blokem yu, mo bambae yu stap long klia ples nomo olsem woman blong rod. Yu bambae yu kasem panis ya from we yu stap wantem tumas ol man, nao yu yu kam woman blong rod blong ol man blong ol narafala kantri, mo yu mekem yu yu kam doti long fes blong mi, long ol aedol ya blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 23:31
content: 31 Yu yu stap mekem ol rabis fasin ya we sista blong yu i stap mekem fastaem, mo bambae mi panisim yu olsem we mi panisim hem.”

title: Ezekiel 23:32
content: 32 Nao Hae God i gohed, i talem se, “Yu bambae yu dring long kap ya blong sista blong yu Sameria,* we kap ya i bigwan we i bigwan. Mo bambae olgeta man oli mekem plei long yu, mo oli laf nogud long yu, from we kap ya i fulap we i fulap gud.

title: Ezekiel 23:33
content: 33 Kap ya blong sista blong yu, we bambae yu dring long hem, bambae i mekem yu yu drong long hem, mo yu harem nogud, we yu fraet we yu fraet, mo bambae yu kasem trabol we bambae i spolemgud yu.

title: Ezekiel 23:34
content: 34 Bambae yu dring gogo yu finisimgud. Nao kap ya bambae i brobrok, mo ol smosmol pis blong hem bambae i katkatem titi blong yu. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yu, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 23:35
content: 35 Mo hem i talem se, “Yu yu fogetem mi finis, mo yu tanem baksaed long mi, mo from samting ya, bambae yu mas harem nogud, from we yu stap wantem tumas ol man, mo yu stap mekem fasin blong woman blong rod.”

title: Ezekiel 23:36
content: 36 Nao long vison ya Hae God i talem long mi se, “?Man blong wol ya. Yu yu rere blong jajem Ohola wetem Oholiba? Oraet, sipos yu rere, yu mas talemaot long tufala ol samting nogud we tufala i stap mekem.

title: Ezekiel 23:37
content: 37 Tufala i woman blong mekem i krangke wetem narafala man, mo tufala i woman blong kilim man i ded. Tufala i lego mi, nao tufala i go mekem i krangke wetem ol aedol ya, mo ol pikinini blong mi we tufala i karem, tufala i kilim olgeta i ded. Tufala i mekem sakrefaes long olgeta, blong givim i go long ol aedol ya, olsem kakae blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 23:38
content: 38 Be i no hemia nomo we tufala i mekem agens long mi, tufala i girap, tufala i mekem haos* blong mi i no moa tabu, mo ol dei we mi mi makemaot blong yufala i spel long hem, tufala i mekem olgeta tu oli no moa tabu.

title: Ezekiel 23:39
content: 39 Long sem dei ya we tufala i kilim ol pikinini blong mi oli ded, blong mekem sakrefaes long ol aedol ya, tufala i go long haos long mi, tufala i mekem i no moa tabu, from we tufala i mekem ol samting ya insaed long haos ya blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 23:40
content: 40 “Oltaem nomo, tufala i stap sanem ol man blong karem tok i go long ol ples we i longwe, blong talem long ol man blong oli kam luk tufala, mo ol man ya oli kam. Oltaem tufala sista ya i stap swim gud, tufala i stap pentem ae blong tufala, mo tufala i stap flasem tufala long ol gudgudfala samting we ol man oli wokem long ol flas ston, blong tufala i givim welkam long ol man ya.

title: Ezekiel 23:41
content: 41 Nao oltaem, tufala i stap sidaon long tu longfala jea blong tufala we i flas gud, mo long fes blong tufala, i gat wan tebol i stap rere, we tufala i putum insens* mo olifoel* long hem we mi bin givim long tufala.

title: Ezekiel 23:42
content: 42 Ol man ya blong karem tok oli go tekem ol man blong draeples oli kam stap wetem tufala, mo ol man olbaot oli save harem noes blong olgeta. Ol man ya oli no stap tingbaot wan samting nating. Oli putum ol strap blong flasem han, long han blong tufala, mo oli putum tu flas hat we i olsem hat blong kwin long hed blong tufala.

title: Ezekiel 23:43
content: 43 Nao mi stap toktok mi wan se, ‘Man, tufala ya i kam olfala olgeta from we tufala i stap slip wetem ol narafala man, be ol man ya oli stap yusum tufala yet.’

title: Ezekiel 23:44
content: 44 Oltaem oli stap go long tufala rabis woman ya, olsem we oli stap go long ol narafala woman blong rod.

title: Ezekiel 23:45
content: 45 Ol stret man bambae oli jajem tufala, olsem we oli stap jajem woman we i slip wetem narafala man, no man we i kilim man i ded. Bambae oli jajem tufala olsem, from we tufala i stap slip wetem ol narafala man, mo from we blad i fulap long han blong tufala.

title: Ezekiel 23:46
content: 46 “I gud sipos wan kampani blong ol man we oli stronghed, oli kam mekem tufala i fraet, mo oli stilim olting blong tufala.

title: Ezekiel 23:47
content: 47 I gud olgeta ya oli stonem tufala, mo oli kilim tufala i ded long naef blong faet, mo oli kilim ol pikinini blong tufala oli ded, mo oli bonemdaon ol haos blong tufala.

title: Ezekiel 23:48
content: 48 Nao long evri ples, bambae mi mekem we fasin nogud ya blong tufala i finis olgeta, blong mekem we ol narafala woman oli luksave we fasin ya i nogud, nao bambae oli no save go slip wetem ol narafala man, olsem we tufala ya i stap mekem.

title: Ezekiel 23:49
content: 49 “Ohola mo Oholiba. Mi bambae mi panisim yutufala from rabis fasin ya we yutufala i stap mekem wetem ol narafala man, mo from ol sin blong yutufala we yutufala i stap mekem wetem ol aedol. Nao bambae yutufala i savegud se mi mi Hae God, mi Masta* blong yutufala.”

title: Ezekiel 24:1
content: 1 Nao long namba naen yia blong yumi we yumi stap wok slef* long Babilonia, long namba ten manis,* long namba ten dei blong hem, Hae God we i Masta* blong yumi i toktok long mi long wan vison bakegen,

title: Ezekiel 24:2
content: 2 i talem se, “Man blong wol ya. Yu makemdaon namba blong dei ya tede, from we tede, king blong Babilonia wetem ol soldia blong hem oli kasem Jerusalem,* oli stap hivap raon long hem blong mekem faet long hem.

title: Ezekiel 24:3
content: 3 Mo mi wantem blong yu go talem wan parabol long ol man ya we oli stap girap agens long mi. Mi mi talem se, ‘Yufala i go putum wan sospen long faea, mo yufala i fulumap wota long hem.

title: Ezekiel 24:4-5
content: 4-5 Nao yufala i go tekem mit blong sipsip we i beswan. Yufala i tekemaot ol nambawan pis blong hem We hemia ol mit blong solda mo leg, wetem ol bun we oli beswan, yufala i putum olgeta i go insaed long sospen ya blong kukum olgeta. Mo yufala i pusum plante faeawud i go aninit long sospen ya blong mekem i boel gud.’ ”

title: Ezekiel 24:6
content: 6 Nao hem i talem se, “Sore tumas long ol man blong taon ya we oli man blong kilim man i ded. Olgeta evriwan bambae oli ded. Olgeta oli olsem sospen we oli wokem long bras, we i rosta we neva oli klinim. Ol pis mit we i stap long hem, ol man oli stap tektekemaot wanwan gogo i finis, i no gat wan i stap.

title: Ezekiel 24:7
content: 7 Ol man oli stap kilim man i ded insaed long taon ya, we blad blong olgeta i no ron i go long graon we bambae asis i save kavremap blong man i no luk, i ron i go long ston nomo.

title: Ezekiel 24:8
content: 8 Mo mi livim blad ya i stap long klia ples nomo, blong mi stap luk oltaem blong mekem mi mi kros, nao mi save panisim olgeta from.

title: Ezekiel 24:9
content: 9 “Sore tumas long ol man blong taon ya we oli man blong kilim man i ded. Olgeta evriwan bambae oli ded. Mi nao bambae mi mekem faea.

title: Ezekiel 24:10
content: 10 Yufala i go tekem ol faeawud bakegen i kam, mo yufala i blu long faea ya blong mekem i laet gud. Yufala i kukum mit ya, we yufala i boelem gogo supsup blong hem i drae olgeta, mo ol bun ya oli bon nogud olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 24:11
content: 11 Nao bambae mi tekem sospen ya we i emti finis, mi putum long sakol faea we i laet gud, blong mekem i hot gogo i red we i red. Bambae mi mekem olsem blong faea i bonemaot ol rosta mo ol doti blong hem, blong mekem i kam klin gud bakegen.

title: Ezekiel 24:12
content: 12 Mi traehad, be no, ol rosta ya, faea i no save bonem evriwan blong i lus olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 24:13
content: 13 “Jerusalem. Rabis fasin ya blong yu i mekem yu yu doti long fes blong mi. Mi traem blong mekem yu yu klin, be yu no wantem, nao yu stap doti sem mak nomo. Bambae yu no save kam klin bakegen gogo yu harem fulpaoa blong kros blong mi.

title: Ezekiel 24:14
content: 14 Naoia i taem blong mi mi mekem tok ya i kamtru. Bambae mi no moa save gat sore long yu, mo mi no save jenisim tingting blong mi. Bambae mi mas lukluk long sin blong yu, mo mi mas panisim yu from ol rabis fasin ya we yu yu mekem. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yu, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 24:15
content: 15 Nao Hae God i toktok long mi bakegen,

title: Ezekiel 24:16
content: 16 i talem se, “Man blong wol ya. Woman ya blong yu, yu yu lavem hem tumas, be bambae mi kam tekemaot hem wantaem nomo. Be bambae yu no mas krae, mo yu no mas mekem singsing blong sore, mo yu no mas letem wota blong ae blong yu i ron.

title: Ezekiel 24:17
content: 17 Sipos yu stap krae smosmol, be yu no mas letem voes blong yu i kamaot, blong man i harem yu. Bambae yu no mas mekem kastom blong yufala blong soemaot we yu harem nogud. Bambae yu no mas tekemaot spesel kaliko ya i gowe long hed blong yu, mo yu no mas tekemaot sandel i gowe long leg blong yu. Bambae yu no mas kavremap fes blong yu, mo yu no mas kakae ol kakae ya we ol man we oli stap harem nogud oli stap kakae.”

title: Ezekiel 24:18
content: 18 Nao long moning ya, mi stap toktok wetem ol man, mo long naet, woman blong mi i ded. Mo long nekis dei blong hem, mi mekem olsem we Hae God i talem long mi.

title: Ezekiel 24:19
content: 19 Nao ol man oli tok long mi se, “?From wanem yu mekem olsem?”

title: Ezekiel 24:20
content: 20 Nao mi talem long olgeta se, “No, be Hae God i talem long mi

title: Ezekiel 24:21
content: 21 blong mi givim tok ya blong hem long yufala ol laen* blong Isrel.* Hem i talem se yufala i flas tumas from paoa blong haos* ya blong hem. Oltaem yufala i wantem lukluk long hem from we i naes we i naes, mo oltaem yufala i wantem go insaed long hem. Be hem bambae i mekem haos ya i no moa tabu. Mo ol pikinini blong yufala we oli stap yet long Jerusalem,* ol yang boe mo ol yang gel bambae oli ded long faet.

title: Ezekiel 24:22
content: 22 Long taem ya, bambae yufala i mekem olsem we mi mi bin mekem. Bambae yufala i no save kavremap fes blong yufala, mo yufala i no save kakae ol kakae ya we ol man we oli stap harem nogud oli stap kakae.

title: Ezekiel 24:23
content: 23 Bambae yufala i no save tekemaot ol spesel kaliko i gowe long hed blong yufala, mo yufala i no save tekemaot sandel i gowe long leg blong yufala, mo yufala i no save krae. Bambae yufala i kam slak olgeta from ol sin blong yufala, mo bambae yufala i stap harem nogud, yufala i stap krakrae long yufala bakegen.

title: Ezekiel 24:24
content: 24 Nao ol samting ya we mi mi mekem, hem i wan saen long yufala. Ol samting ya i mas kasem yufala. Mo Hae God i talem se taem ol samting ya oli kamtru, bambae yufala i savegud we hem i Hae God, i Masta* blong yufala.”

title: Ezekiel 24:25
content: 25 Nao Hae God i talem se, “Haos ya blong mi, ol man ya oli glad tumas long hem, mo oli praod tumas from. Oltaem oli wantem lukluk long hem from we i naes we i naes, mo oltaem oli wantem go insaed long hem, be mi bambae mi tekemaot i gowe long olgeta. Mo bambae mi tekemaot ol pikinini boe blong olgeta wetem ol dota blong olgeta tu.

title: Ezekiel 24:26
content: 26 Nao long dei ya we bambae mi mekem samting ya, bambae wan man i ronwe long trabol ya i kam talemaot nius blong hem long yu.

title: Ezekiel 24:27
content: 27 Longtaem finis yu yu no save toktok, be long sem taem we man ya bambae i kamtru, bambae yu yu save toktok bakegen, nao yu save toktok wetem hem. Mo long fasin ya bambae yu yu wan saen long ol man ya. Mo bambae oli savegud we mi mi Hae God.”

title: Ezekiel 25:1
content: 1 Nao Hae God i toktok long mi long wan vison bakegen,

title: Ezekiel 25:2
content: 2 i talem se, “Man blong wol ya. Yu lukluk i go long kantri ya Amon,

title: Ezekiel 25:3
content: 3 yu tok agens long ol man blong hem. Yu talem long olgeta we mi mi talem se, ‘Ol man Amon. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta* blong olgeta man, mo yufala i mas lesin gud long ol samting we mi mi stap talem long yufala. Yufala i glad tumas we yufala i luk haos* blong mi i kam doti, i no moa tabu. Mo yufala i glad we kantri ya Juda* i kam nogud olgeta, mo ol man blong hem oli go wok slef* long narafala kantri.

title: Ezekiel 25:4
content: 4 Nao from we yufala i stap glad from ol samting ya, bambae mi letem ol man ya blong draeples long is oli kam mekem faet long yufala, oli winim yufala. Mo bambae oli putumap ol haos tapolen blong olgeta long kantri ya blong yufala, nao bambae oli stap long hem. Mo bambae oli kakae ol kakae mo ol frut blong yufala, mo oli dring melek blong ol anamol blong yufala.

title: Ezekiel 25:5
content: 5 Bambae mi mekem taon ya Raba i kam wan ples blong putum ol kamel long hem, mo evri taon long kantri ya Amon, bambae mi mekem olgeta oli kam ples blong sipsip, nao bambae yufala i savegud we mi mi Hae God.”

title: Ezekiel 25:6
content: 6 “ ‘Yufala i no wantem nating kantri ya blong ol laen* blong Isrel.* Yufala i stap klapem han blong yufala mo yufala i stap jamjam from we yufala i glad tumas we kantri ya i lus.

title: Ezekiel 25:7
content: 7 Nao from we yufala i mekem olsem, bambae mi letem yufala i go long han blong ol man blong ol narafala kantri we bambae oli kam mekem faet long yufala, nao oli stilim olting blong yufala. Bambae mi spolemgud yufala we bambae mi flatemgud yufala, nao bambae yufala i no moa kam plante, blong yufala i save gat kantri blong yufala bakegen. Nao bambae yufala i savegud we mi mi Hae God.’ ”

title: Ezekiel 25:8
content: 8 Nao Hae God i talem se, “Ol man blong kantri ya Moab oli stap talem se Juda* i no moa gat man i lukaot long hem, hem i olsem ol narafala kantri nomo.

title: Ezekiel 25:9
content: 9 Be from we oli tok olsem, mi bambae mi letem ol enemi oli kam mekem faet long ol nambawan taon blong olgeta. Ol taon ya Betsesimot, mo Balmeon, mo Kiriataem oli stap long mak blong graon blong kantri ya, blong blokemgud hem, be bambae ol enemi ya oli flatemgud olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 25:10
content: 10 Bambae mi letem ol man ya blong draeples long is oli kam faet long olgeta wetem ol man Amon, oli winim olgeta, blong bambae ol man Moab oli no moa gat kantri blong olgeta bakegen.

title: Ezekiel 25:11
content: 11 Mi bambae mi panisim olgeta, nao bambae oli savegud we mi mi Hae God.”

title: Ezekiel 25:12
content: 12 Nao Hae God i talem se, “Ol man blong kantri ya Edom oli faet long ol man Juda* blong givimbak fasin we oli mekem, be oli mekem i nogud moa, nao sin blong olgeta bambae i stap olwe.

title: Ezekiel 25:13
content: 13 Naoia mi talem se bambae mi panisim olgeta we bambae mi kilim olgeta man wetem olgeta anamol tu. Bambae mi spolem kantri ya we bambae mi mekem i kam drae nogud olgeta, i stat long taon ya Teman i go kasem taon ya Dedan, mo olgeta man evriwan bambae oli ded long faet.

title: Ezekiel 25:14
content: 14 “Ol laen* blong Isrel* oli man blong mi, mo bambae oli mekem wok blong mi. Bambae oli go faet long ol man Edom blong givimbak ol fasin ya we oli mekem, nao olgeta ya bambae oli haremsave paoa blong kros blong mi. Bambae oli save fasin blong mi blong givimbak ol samting ya we oli mekem. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta* blong yufala, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 25:15
content: 15 Mo Hae God i talem se, “Ol man blong kantri ya Filistia oli kam mekem faet long ol man Juda* we oli enemi blong olgeta. Oli stap agens long ol man ya, i stat longtaem finis, i kam kasem tede. Olgeta oli mekem faet ya blong givimbak fasin ya we ol man Juda ya oli bin mekem long olgeta, mo oli spolemgud olgeta, from we oli no laekem olgeta nating.

title: Ezekiel 25:16
content: 16 Nao from samting ya, mi talemaot se bambae mi mekem faet long olgeta ya we bambae mi flatemgud olgeta evriwan. Olgeta evriwan we oli stap olbaot long levelples ya long Filistia klosap long solwota, bambae mi kilim olgeta evriwan oli ded.

title: Ezekiel 25:17
content: 17 Bambae mi panisim olgeta we mi meksave olgeta blong givimbak ol fasin ya we oli bin mekem. Nao bambae oli haremsave paoa blong kros blong mi, mo bambae oli savegud we mi mi Hae God.”

title: Ezekiel 26:1
content: 1 Nao long namba leven yia blong yumi we yumi stap wok slef* long Babilonia, long fas dei blong manis, Hae God i toktok long mi long wan vison,

title: Ezekiel 26:2
content: 2 i talem se, “Man blong wol ya. Ol man blong taon ya Taea oli stap glad, oli stap singsingaot bigwan. Oli stap talem se, ‘!Naoia ol enemi oli flatem Jerusalem* finis! !Oli brebrekemgud taon ya! !Paoa blong hem blong wokem bisnes i finis olgeta! !Yumi save holem ol bisnes blong hem nao! !Hem i lus finis!’

title: Ezekiel 26:3
content: 3 “Nao from samting ya, mi mi tok agens long taon ya Taea, mi talem se, ‘Taea. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta* blong olgeta man, mo naoia mi mi enemi blong yu. Bambae mi tekem ol man blong ol narafala kantri oli kam mekem faet long yu. Bambae oli kam olsem ol bigbigfala swel blong solwota, nao bambae oli kavremap yu.

title: Ezekiel 26:4
content: 4 Bambae oli brebrekem bigfala stonwol blong yu, mo oli brebrekemdaon ol wajhaos blong yu. Nao bambae mi brumumaot ol doti blong yu i gowe, mo bigfala ston ya we yu yu stap stanap long hem, bambae i stap nating nomo.

title: Ezekiel 26:5
content: 5 Bambae hem i stanap long medel blong solwota mo ol man blong pulum fis bambae oli stap putum ol net blong olgeta long hem blong oli drae. Bambae ol man blong ol narafala kantri oli winim yu, nao oli karemaot olting blong yu i blong olgeta.

title: Ezekiel 26:6
content: 6 Mo bambae oli kilim olgeta man we oli stap long ol vilej ya blong yu we oli stap long menlan. Nao bambae yu yu savegud we mi mi Hae God. Mi mi Masta blong olgeta man, mo hemia tok blong mi.’ ”

title: Ezekiel 26:7
content: 7 Mo hem i talem se, “Taea. King Nebukadnesa blong Babilonia, we hem i hae moa long ol narafala king, mi bambae mi tekem hem i kam mekem faet long yu. Bambae hem i aot long saed long not, i kam wetem wan bigfala kampani blong ol soldia blong hem, wetem ol hos, mo ol kat blong faet, mo ol soldia we oli ron long hos.

title: Ezekiel 26:8
content: 8 Mo olgeta man we oli stap long ol vilej ya blong yu long menlan, bambae oli ded evriwan long faet ya. Bambae ol enemi ya oli digim ol hol, mo oli hivimap graon, mo oli stanap laen wetem ol sil* blong olgeta, blong mekem faet long yu.

title: Ezekiel 26:9
content: 9 Mo bambae oli yusum ol bigbigfala wud blong brebrekem bigfala stonwol blong yu, mo oli yusum aean blong smasem ol wajhaos blong yu.

title: Ezekiel 26:10
content: 10 Mo smok blong asis blong graon we ol hos blong olgeta oli mekem, bambae i kavremap yu, from we ol hos ya oli plante we plante. Mo ol hos we oli pulum ol kat blong faet, wetem ol hos we oli pulum ol kat we oli karem olting blong olgeta, bambae oli resis i gotru long ol doa* blong bigfala stonwol blong yu, nao bambae noes blong olgeta i mekem stonwol ya i seksek. Bambae oli resis i go insaed long yu, olsem we ol man oli stap resis i go insaed long taon we bigfala stonwol blong hem i brobrok finis.

title: Ezekiel 26:11
content: 11 Mo bambae ol soldia we oli ron long hos oli go olbaot long ol rod blong yu, oli kilim olgeta man blong yu long naef blong faet blong olgeta. Mo ol bigbigfala pos blong ol haos blong yu, olgeta ya bambae oli brebrekemdaon olgeta evriwan.

title: Ezekiel 26:12
content: 12 Mo ol enemi ya blong yu bambae oli tektekemaot ol gudgudfala samting blong yu, mo ol samting ya we yu stap salem, bambae oli karem i blong olgeta. Nao bambae oli brebrekem bigfala stonwol blong yu, mo bambae oli brebrekem ol haos ya blong yu we oli flas we i flas. Nao bambae oli karemaot ol ston wetem ol timba blong hem mo ol doti blong hem, oli sakem olgeta i go long solwota.

title: Ezekiel 26:13
content: 13 Mo bambae mi mekem we yu no moa stap singsing, mo yu no moa stap plei long gita blong yu.

title: Ezekiel 26:14
content: 14 Mo bambae mi livim ston ya we yu yu stap stanap long hem i stap nating nomo, nao ol man blong pulum fis bambae oli save putum ol net blong olgeta long hem blong oli drae. Nao bambae i no moa gat man i save wokemgud yu bakegen samtaem. Mi mi Hae God, mi Masta blong yu, mo hemia tok blong mi.”

title: Ezekiel 26:15
